#IMA Lt Gen Gurmit Singh, PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, VSM (Retd), Hon’ble Governor of Uttarakhand, addressed the Officer Cadets at the Indian Military Academy, Dehradun on the theme “Indian Army Officer as a Nation Builder.” He emphasised Nation First – Rashtra Sarvo Pari, the legacy of supreme sacrifice and the noble responsibility of leadership in uniform. Highlighting that learning is a continuous process, he spoke about the vital bond between officers and men in units and the evolving character of modern warfare involving AI, cyber, space and quantum technologies, as well as hybrid and proxy conflicts. Drawing inspiration from Guru Gobind Singh Ji, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Maharana Pratap, he reminded officer cadets that an officer must be a soldier, a scholar and a saint prepared to safeguard national security and contribute to nation building, while also acknowledging the growing role of women in the Armed Forces. #IndianArmy #IMA_Dehradun @LtGenGurmit @suryacommand @NorthernComd_IA @IaSouthern @easterncomd @IndiannavyMedia @IAF_MCC @SWComd_IA @westerncomd_IA @AN_Command @artrac_ia @adgpi

𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀: 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝗡𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴

Educational initiatives supported by #WhiteKnightCorps under the aegis of #NorthernCommand continue to empower talented youth across Jammu & Kashmir, with students from the 𝗔𝗸𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗼𝗿 𝗜𝗴𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗱𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 and 𝗣𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘁 𝗝𝗮𝗺𝗺𝘂 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗲𝗿-𝟯𝟬 achieving outstanding success in #JEEAdvanced2026.

𝗣𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘁 𝗝𝗮𝗺𝗺𝘂 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗲𝗿-𝟯𝟬 (#CIFRomeo), conducted under the aegis of the Indian Army at Reasi in collaboration with 𝗣𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘁 𝗟𝗡𝗚 𝗟𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 and CSRL, achieved a significant milestone, with 𝟮𝟬 𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝟮𝟴 students qualifying JEE Main and 𝟭𝟯 successfully clearing JEE Advanced 2026. Simultaneously, the 𝗔𝗸𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗼𝗿 𝗜𝗴𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗱𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 (#CrossedSwordsDivision), a CSR project of 𝗔𝗿𝗺𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗩𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗡𝗶𝗴𝗮𝗺 𝗟𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 in collaboration with the Indian Army and NIEDO, saw two students successfully qualify JEE Advanced 2026. 

𝗧𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗲 𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀' 𝗲𝗻𝗱𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗵 𝗲𝗺𝗽𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗲𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝗼𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀, 𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗻𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗰𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗰𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗻𝘀.

On receipt of information regarding the overturning of a passenger vehicle near Army Check Post at Nachlana on NH-44, 𝗧𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗽𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀 responded with 𝗦𝘄𝗶𝗳𝘁𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝗺. All 12 occupants, including 03 children, were safely evacuated and provided 𝗜𝗺𝗺𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗔𝗶𝗱 before being handed over to the civil administration and @jmukmrpolice for further care.

with other security agencies across respective areas of responsibility.

The #GOC interacted with troops and appreciated 𝗶𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲𝘀 enhancing operational effectiveness. He lauded their 𝗲𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝘃𝗶𝗴𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗹𝗲 and 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗳𝗮𝘀𝘁 𝗱𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 towards safeguarding the nation under challenging conditions.

#𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀 | #𝗦𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗧𝗼𝘂𝗿 | #𝗜𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗬𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗵

From remote areas of 𝗦𝗮𝘂𝗷𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗻, 𝗣𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗵, 𝟯𝟯 𝘀𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝟰 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿𝘀 from Army Goodwill School, Saujiyan, embarked on a transformative journey under the aegis of 𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀. The tour included their first train journey and exposure to 𝗦𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗿 and 𝗝𝗮𝗺𝗺𝘂. Interaction with senior Army leadership, a meeting with the 𝗛𝗼𝗻’𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗟𝗶𝗲𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗼𝗿, a tank ride and visits to iconic locations turned curiosity into confidence and aspirations into purpose.

The students returned with brighter smiles, stronger belief and dreams that soar higher, reflecting the Indian Army’s commitment to nation-building and youth empowerment.

#𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀 | #𝗢𝗽𝗦𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗰𝘂𝗲 | #𝗛𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗻𝗔𝘀𝘀𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲

𝗦𝗪𝗜𝗙𝗧 𝗥𝗘𝗦𝗖𝗨𝗘 𝗔𝗧 𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗛𝗔𝗡 𝗧𝗢𝗣

On 𝟭𝟱 𝗠𝗮𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲, information was received regarding 𝟮𝟯𝟱 𝗰𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗮𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝟯𝟴 𝘃𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 stranded at 𝗦𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝗧𝗼𝗽 in general area of 𝗞𝗶𝘀𝗵𝘁𝘄𝗮𝗿, due to 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝘃𝘆 𝘀𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗳𝗮𝗹𝗹 and 𝘀𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝘄𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀. Troops of #𝗪𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗞𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝘀 were immediately mobilised to launch a 𝘀𝘄𝗶𝗳𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗰𝘂𝗲 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 despite 𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻 and 𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗹𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝘀𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗳𝗮𝗹𝗹.

Braving 𝗲𝘅𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲 𝘄𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 and 𝘀𝗻𝗼𝘄-𝗯𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝗿𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀, rescue teams reached 𝗦𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝗧𝗼𝗽 and stranded civilians were provided 𝗵𝗼𝘁 𝗺𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘀, 𝗱𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 and 𝘀𝗵𝗲𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗿. 𝗥𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗿 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺𝘀 restored mobility of stranded vehicles, while passengers from 𝘂𝗻𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘃𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 were safely evacuated. 𝗠𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺𝘀 rendered assistance and 𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗺𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀 to those in need.

The operation concluded successfully, with 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗰𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗮𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘃𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 safely escorted to safety. The mission witnessed 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗺𝗹𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝗼𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 between 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮𝗻 𝗔𝗿𝗺𝘆, 𝗝&𝗞 𝗣𝗼𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗲 and 𝗡𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗜𝗻𝗳𝗿𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗽𝗼𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗟𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 (𝗡𝗛𝗜𝗗𝗖𝗟), reaffirming the 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮𝗻 𝗔𝗿𝗺𝘆’𝘀 𝘂𝗻𝘄𝗮𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 to safeguarding lives in the 𝗵𝗮𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀.

𝗪𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗲, 𝗪𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁!

Operation KIYA

Indian Army’s HADR operations once again stood tall as nature turned harsh, with troops of #WhiteKnightCorps providing timely relief and reassurance. Amid unprecedented snowfall across the Jammu region today, troops swiftly undertook HADR operations to assist stranded civilians and tourists, including women and children, who were left without food or water due to road blockades at multiple locations.

The stranded individuals were safely evacuated to warm shelters and provided adequate food, water, warm clothing and medical first aid across areas of both #CIF Romeo and #CIF Delta. This humanitarian assistance reflects the Indian Army’s core values, compassion and its unwavering ethos of service to the nation—always with the people, for the people.

#WhiteKnightCorps | #DhruvaBikeRally | #Day8

Standing with Our Veterans

Veterans’ Day events at Poonch commenced with a respectful homage at the War Memorial, honouring those who served the nation with courage and unwavering dedication. This was followed by a community health outreach, wherein medical consultations were conducted and BP monitoring devices were handed over to Ex-Servicemen and their families under the ‘Aarogya Rakshak’ initiative. Representatives from the civil administration and the Armed Forces interacted with veterans, reaffirming the Army’s enduring bond with its extended family.

Later in the day, the Dhruva Motorcycle Rally, carrying the Eternal Mashaal from Mendhar, flagged off from Poonch, symbolising togetherness, shared pride and the spirit of ‘Service Beyond Uniform’. The rally reached Rajouri, further reinforcing the message of unity, gratitude and lasting respect for those who have served the nation.

#WhiteKnightCorps | #NationalIntegrationTour | #OperationSadbhavana

A Journey of Learning, Unity and National Pride

Flagged in today by the #GOC, White Knight Corps at Nagrota, the National Integration Tour under #OperationSadbhavana marked the successful culmination of a meaningful and enriching journey undertaken by students and faculty of Government Degree College, Poonch.

The #NationalIntegrationTour, organised by the #IndianArmy under #OperationSadbhavana, was earlier flagged off with pride on 03 Jan 2026, with the aim of providing young participants a deeper understanding of India’s heritage, democratic institutions and national values.

During the tour, the participants witnessed an impressive weapon display and paid homage at the National War Memorial, India Gate and Param Yodha Sthal. A defining highlight was an interaction with the Hon’ble President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan, followed by visits to the National Museum and PM Sangrahalaya. The itinerary further included visits to the Taj Mahal at Agra, an interaction with the Chief of Air Staff, spiritual engagement at the Golden Temple, witnessing the Attari Border Retreat Ceremony, and paying tribute at Jallianwala Bagh.

Addressing the participants, the #GOC, #WhiteKnightCorps encouraged them to pursue excellence, uphold national values and contribute meaningfully to nation-building. Such initiatives continue to inspire youth and strengthen national integration.

We Serve, We Protect!

Since its raising as part of Indian Artillery and later, re-designated in 1994, as the Army Air Defence Corps, it has consistently proven its worth through execution on the battlefield. By delivering continuous air defence cover using guns, missiles, radars and integrated command-and-control systems, the Corps has enabled ground formations to operate with freedom of manoeuvre during wars, operations and sustained high-alert deployments.

On Army Air Defence Corps Day, we acknowledge a legacy defined not by mandate, but by performance - persistent surveillance, swift engagement and seamless integration in joint air defence frameworks. The professionalism, precision and vigilance of all ranks - past and present - remain decisive in denying the adversary air advantage.

Honouring Our Veterans | #VeteransBikeRally | #Day1

As part of the 10th Veterans’ Day being celebrated across the nation, with the Northern Command events for Veterans Day planned at Rajouri on 13 - 14 Jan 2026, the Dhruva Motorcycle Rally was organised as the first lead-up engagement to honour the valour and sacrifices of Ex-Servicemen. The rally was flagged off from Udhampur on 05 Jan 2026 and will traverse the Jammu region up to 13 Jan 2026, covering key locations en route. During the journey, the rally team will interact with veterans and their families, pay homage at War Memorials and extend medical support through health camps and distribution of essential medical aids, reaffirming the Army’s enduring commitment to veteran welfare.

The rally was led for the first leg from Udhampur to Nagrota by Lt Gen Pratik Sharma, Army Commander, Northern Command, along with the GOC, White Knight Corps. On completion of the first leg, the rally was flagged in at Nagrota Military Station by the Chief of Staff, #WhiteKnightCorps.

The Dhruva Motorcycle Rally stands as a symbolic and operational tribute to India’s veterans, aimed at strengthening bonds with the veteran community, inspiring the youth and reinforcing national pride in the run-up to the 10th Veterans’ Day celebrations.

We Serve, We Protect!

Security forces have successfully concluded  Operation Radd-ul-Fitna-1 in Balochistan under which a series of coordinated, swift, and intelligence driven operations were conducted against Indian sponsored terrorist elements seeking to disrupt peace and development by targeting innocent civilians, including women and children.

On 29 January 2026, operations were initiated in Panjgur and the outskirts of Harnai District after credible and verified intelligence confirmed the presence of terrorist elements posing an imminent threat to local public. During this phase, Security Forces undertook operations against identified terrorist hideouts, resulting in the elimination of 41 terrorists affiliated with Indian proxy networks.

Subsequently, aggressive and steadfast responses by the brave security forces effectively thwarted the desparate attacks of of Fitna al Hindustan to destabilise the peace of Balochistan.  Sequel to these a broader series of intelligence-based operations were launched in multiple areas to dismantle terrorist sleeper cells through sustained combing and sanitisation operations. 

Through meticulous planning, actionable intelligence, and seamless joint execution Pakistan’s Security Forces and Law Enforcement Agencies with support of Intelligence Agencies under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna-1 responded with precision and resolve. As a result of these well-coordinated engagements and subsequent clearance operations, 216 terrorists have been  sent to hell, significantly degrading the leadership, command-and-control structures and operational capabilities of terrorist networks.

A substantial cache of foreign-origin weapons, ammunition, explosives and equipment has also been recovered during the process. Preliminary analysis indicates systematic external facilitation and logistical support to these extremist proxies.

During these operations, 36 innocent civilians, including women and children, embraced shahadat, while 22 brave Security Forces and Law Enforcement Agencies’ personnel made the ultimate sacrifice in defence of Pakistan’s territorial integrity and the protection of its citizens. Their courage, professionalism, and unwavering commitment reflect the highest traditions of service. The Nation honours their sacrifice and stands in solidarity with the families of all martyrs.

He interacted with and addressed the troops, encouraging them to maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and readiness in challenging conditions. पूर्वी सिक्किम के अत्यंत ऊँचाई वाले क्षेत्र में जनरल ऑफिसर कमांडिंग, त्रिशक्ति कोर ने एक ऑपरेशनल फॉर्मेशन का दौरा कर उसकी तैयारी की समीक्षा की। उन्हें अग्रिम कमांडरों द्वारा ऑपरेशनल पहलुओं पर जानकारी दी गई। उन्होंने सैनिकों से बातचीत की और उन्हें संबोधित करते हुए कठिन परिस्थितियों में उच्चतम स्तर की ऑपरेशनल क्षमता और सतर्कता बनाए रखने के लिए प्रेरित किया। #IndianArmy #TrishaktiCorps #EastSikkim #HighAltitude #OperationalReadiness 🇮🇳 @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD

Operational Readiness in Super High Altitude Areas 🇮🇳 The General Officer Commanding, Trishakti Corps, visited an operational formation in North #Sikkim to review its preparedness in the challenging Super High Altitude Area terrain. He interacted with the troops and encouraged them to maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and readiness in challenging conditions. उत्तर सिक्किम के अत्यंत ऊँचाई वाले क्षेत्र में जनरल ऑफिसर कमांडिंग, त्रिशक्ति कोर ने एक ऑपरेशनल फॉर्मेशन का दौरा कर उसकी तैयारी की समीक्षा की। उन्होंने सैनिकों से बातचीत की और कठिन परिस्थितियों में उच्चतम स्तर की ऑपरेशनल क्षमता और सतर्कता बनाए रखने के लिए प्रेरित किया। #IndianArmy #TrishaktiCorps #NorthSikkim #HighAltitude #OperationalReadiness 🇮🇳 @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD

🇮🇳✨ From North Bengal to Kartavya Path NCC cadets from schools of North #Bengal turned distance into destiny as they marched on Kartavya Path at the #RepublicDay Parade 2026. Carrying India’s Tiranga with pride, they displayed discipline and national spirit. The cadets were felicitated for their outstanding achievement. #TrishaktiCorps salutes these young leaders — supported by the Indian Army. 🇮🇳 उत्तर बंगाल के स्कूलों के एनसीसी कैडेट्स ने गणतंत्र दिवस परेड 2026 में कर्तव्य पथ पर मार्च कर गर्व से तिरंगा लहराया। उन्होंने अनुशासन और देशभक्ति का शानदार प्रदर्शन किया। इन कैडेट्स को उनकी उपलब्धि के लिए सम्मानित किया गया। #TrishaktiCorps भारतीय सेना के साथ इन युवा नेताओं को सलाम करता है। 🇮🇳 #Nationfirst #NCC @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD

Army boxer shines in Spain #IndianArmy athlete Havildar Jadumani Singh secured a Bronze Medal in the Bantamweight category at the Boxam Elite International 2026 held in #Spain. The competition saw participation from leading international #boxers. The result reflects the Indian Army’s continued focus on sports and the development of #soldier athletes. स्पेन में आयोजित Boxam Elite International 2026 प्रतियोगिता में भारतीय सेना के खिलाड़ी हवलदार जदुमणि सिंह ने बैंटमवेट वर्ग में कांस्य पदक प्राप्त किया। इस प्रतियोगिता में कई अंतरराष्ट्रीय मुक्केबाज़ों ने भाग लिया। @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

Indian Army–ICFAI University MoU on Education & Skill Development #IndianArmy signed an MoU with ICFAI University, #Sikkim to expand academic, research and skilling opportunities for serving personnel, #veterans, #VeerNaris and their wards. The MoU provides a 30% tuition fee concession for all Indian Army beneficiaries, with an additional 10% concession for Veer Naris and their wards, along with hybrid doctoral programmes, credit transfer for military courses and customised academic modules. भारतीय सेना और ICFAI यूनिवर्सिटी, सिक्किम के बीच हुए एमओयू से सैनिकों, पूर्व सैनिकों, वीर नारियों और उनके बच्चों को शिक्षा और कौशल विकास के अवसर मिलेंगे। सभी लाभार्थियों को 30% फीस छूट, जबकि वीर नारियों और उनके परिवारों को अतिरिक्त 10% छूट दी जाएगी। इसके साथ हाइब्रिड डॉक्टरेट कार्यक्रम, क्रेडिट ट्रांसफर और विशेष पाठ्यक्रम भी उपलब्ध होंगे। यह पहल Whole-of-Nation Approach के तहत सैन्य-शैक्षणिक सहयोग को मजबूत करती है। #DecadeOfTransformation @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

IAS Officer Trainees on Military Attachment | Strengthening Military-Civil Synergy for National Security 41 IAS Officer Trainees from LBSNAA underwent Army Life familiarisation with Trishakti Corps during a week-long Forward Area Attachment in Sikkim. The officers visited Bardang Prernasthal, Nathu La, Baba Harbhajan Singh Shrine, Ganju Lama War Memorial & Tsomgo Lake, gaining first-hand insight into the challenging life of soldiers in high-altitude areas. LBSNAA के 41 IAS अधिकारी प्रशिक्षुओं ने सिक्किम में सप्ताह भर के फॉरवर्ड एरिया अटैचमेंट के दौरान त्रिशक्ति कोर के साथ आर्मी लाइफ का अनुभव लिया। प्रशिक्षुओं ने नाथू ला, बाबा हरभजन सिंह स्मारक और छांगू झील सहित प्रमुख स्थलों का दौरा कर ऊँचाई वाले इलाकों में सैनिकों के कठिन जीवन को नजदीक से समझा। #NationFirst #CivilMilitarySynergy #Sikkim #BharatRannBhoomiDarshan @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @LBSNAA_Official

Transforming Lives in Remote Border Areas 🏫 Indian Army, through Trishakti Corps, organised a medical camp at Tea Garden Primary School, Telepara ,North #Bengal.Dental check ups, health screening and awareness talks were conducted for school children, with focus on balanced nutrition and personal hygiene. दूरदराज़ क्षेत्र में टी गार्डन प्राइमरी स्कूल, टेलीपारा (हल्दीबाड़ी) में भारतीय सेना द्वारा चिकित्सा शिविर आयोजित किया गया। इस दौरान 255 बच्चों का स्वास्थ्य परीक्षण, दंत जांच तथा पोषण और व्यक्तिगत स्वच्छता पर जागरूकता दी गई। Committed to a healthier India — the Indian Army stands with the people. 💙🙌 #IndianArmy #MedicalCamp #MedicalOutreach #CommunityHealth #ViksitBharatBudget @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

National Integration Tour The #IndianArmy conducted a National Integration Tour for students of Government Secondary School, Nandok, #Sikkim, to promote national integration and youth empowerment through exposure to India’s cultural and institutional heritage. Students visited key locations in West #Bengal, interacted with eminent dignitaries including the Hon’ble Governor of West Bengal, and explored places of national importance, reinforcing India’s unity in diversity. राष्ट्रीय एकता यात्रा के माध्यम से नंदोक, सिक्किम के छात्रों को देश की संस्कृति और विरासत के बारे में जानकारी दी गई। छात्रों ने पश्चिम बंगाल के प्रमुख स्थानों का भ्रमण किया और भारत की एकता व विविधता को करीब से समझा। #CommunityFirst #NationFirst #ServiceBeforeSelf @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

Trishakti Corps Distributes Solar Lamps to BPL Families in Remote Border Villages of North Bengal Indian Army, under Trishakti Corps, in collaboration with Himalayan Unnati Mission, gifted #solar lamps to BPL families in remote border villages of North #Bengal. The initiative improves access to sustainable lighting, enhancing safety and daily life in border communities. उत्तर बंगाल के दूरस्थ सीमावर्ती गांवों में बीपीएल परिवारों को सोलर लैंप भेंट किए गए। यह पहल हिमालयन उन्नति मिशन के सहयोग से की गई, जिससे ऐसे घरों में रोशनी पहुँची है जहाँ बिजली की सुविधा सीमित है। इससे बच्चों की पढ़ाई, परिवारों की सुरक्षा और दैनिक कार्यों में सुविधा मिलेगी। #NationFirst @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

सर्वे सन्तु निरामया” — May All Be Free from Illness In a continued series of outreach initiatives, medical camps were organised by the #IndianArmy at Rhenock, Zuluk and Kupup in East #Sikkim, with strong participation from locals and veterans. Comprehensive consultations, basic diagnostics and medicines were provided to address key healthcare needs. The series culminated at Kupup on the occasion of World Cancer Day, reinforcing commitment towards community health, veterans care and a strong civil–military bond. रेनॉक, ज़ुलुक एवं कुपुप, पूर्वी #सिक्किम में #IndianArmy द्वारा चिकित्सा शिविरों की श्रृंखला आयोजित की गई, जिसमें स्थानीय नागरिकों और पूर्व सैनिकों की उत्साहपूर्ण भागीदारी रही। व्यापक चिकित्सा परामर्श, प्राथमिक जांच एवं दवाएं प्रदान की गईं। यह श्रृंखला विश्व कैंसर दिवस के अवसर पर कुपुप में संपन्न हुई, जिससे सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य, पूर्व सैनिकों की देखभाल और नागरिक–सैन्य संबंध और सुदृढ़ हुए। #IndianArmy #Sikkim #CommunityOutreach #Veterans #WorldCancerDay @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

Solar Energy Infrastructure in North #Sikkim A 10 kVA solar power plant at Thangu and solar street lights at Samdong, Yathang and Thangu, established by #TrishaktiCorps of the #IndianArmy, are improving safety, mobility and daily life in North Sikkim. These sustainable energy initiatives are supporting villages affected by Glacial Floods, at an altitude of 15,000 feet. थांगू में 10 केवीए सोलर पावर प्लांट और समडोंग, याथांग व थांगू में सोलर स्ट्रीट लाइट्स, भारतीय सेना की त्रिशक्ति कोर द्वारा स्थापित, उत्तर सikkim में सुरक्षा और दैनिक जीवन को बेहतर बना रही हैं। ये पहल 15,000 फीट की ऊँचाई पर, ग्लेशियल फ्लड से प्रभावित गांवों को सहायता दे रही हैं। @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

Celebrating Courage | MUSKAN Inclusive Sports Carnival Lt Gen Man Raj Singh Mann, GOC #TrishaktiCorps & Mrs Ritu Mann, Zonal President #AWWA joined young champions at the 37th Annual Inclusive Sports Carnival ‘MUSKAN’ at Siliguri, organised by the North Bengal Council for the Disabled and supported by the #IndianArmy. With participation from 25 schools and 450 specially-abled young athletes, the event celebrated resilience, confidence and the indomitable human spirit. #WeCare #HarKaamDeshKeNaam @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

Army Day | Honouring the Brave On #ArmyDay, Lt Gen Man Raj Singh Mann, GOC Trishakti Corps, laid a wreath at the Trishakti War Memorial, Sukna Military Station, paying solemn tribute to the courage, sacrifice and supreme service of our brave soldiers. 🇮🇳 आर्मी डे के अवसर पर लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल मान राज सिंह मान, जीओसी त्रिशक्ति कोर, ने सुकना मिलिट्री स्टेशन स्थित त्रिशक्ति युद्ध स्मारक पर पुष्पांजलि अर्पित कर हमारे वीर सैनिकों के बलिदान को नमन किया। #ArmyDay #TrishaktiCorps #IndianArmy #HonouringHeroes #Sukna @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

ESM Rally in North #Bengal | Veteran Welfare Outreach ESM Rally 2025 was organised at Binnaguri Military Station, benefiting more than 750 Ex-Servicemen, Veer Naris & dependents. Key highlights included medical camps, SPARSH & ECHS support, legal & resettlement guidance, cyber awareness sessions and cultural performances. उत्तर बंगाल में आयोजित ESM रैली 2025 में 750 se jyada पूर्व सैनिकों, वीर नारियों व उनके परिवारों को चिकित्सा, कल्याण, पुनर्वास मार्गदर्शन और सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से सहायता प्रदान की गई। #IndianArmyCares #Veterans #ESMRally 🇮🇳 @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @BengalGovernor @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD @OfficialAwwa

Strengthening Connectivity & Resilience in #Sikkim GOC #TrishaktiCorps interacted with Director General Border Roads (DGBR) to review and coordinate road infrastructure development in #Sikkim following the GLOF Glacial Lake Outburst Flood in 2023. Focus was on road restoration, upgrades and improved connectivity for long term resilience. GOC त्रिशक्ति कोर ने डायरेक्टर जनरल बॉर्डर रोड्स (DGBR) के साथ #Sikkim में GLOF (ग्लेशियल लेक आउटबर्स्ट फ्लड) 2023 के बाद सड़क ढांचे की समीक्षा की। सड़कों की मरम्मत, उन्नयन और बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी पर जोर दिया गया। #IndianArmy #Sikkim #Infrastructure #NationBuilding 🇮🇳 @adgpi @easterncomd @IAF_MCC @HQ_IDS_India @indiannavy @GovernorSikkim @PIBGangtok @Sikkimgovt @prodefgau @SpokespersonMoD

A Tribute Through Care and Commitment  

An Veterans Rally was organised at Bagrakote Military Station, attended by #Veterans, their families and Veer Naris. Officials from SPARSH, Record Offices, Zila Sainik Board, Army Placement Node and banks addressed pension, welfare, financial and resettlement issues, and shared details of government schemes. Medical teams from the Indian Army provided medical, eye, dental and surgical care. We honour our Veterans and their sacrifices. 🇮🇳

बगराकोट मिलिट्री स्टेशन पर पूर्व सैनिक रैली आयोजित की गई। इसमें पूर्व सैनिक, उनके परिवार, वीर नारियाँ और युद्ध के दिग्गज शामिल हुए। SPARSH, रिकॉर्ड कार्यालय, जिला सैनिक बोर्ड, आर्मी प्लेसमेंट नोड और बैंक ने पेंशन, कल्याण, वित्त और पुनर्वास से जुड़ी समस्याओं पर मार्गदर्शन दिया और सरकारी योजनाओं की जानकारी दी।
 भारतीय सेना की मेडिकल टीमों ने इलाज, आंखों और दांतों की जांच तथा आवश्यक उपचार किया। हम अपने पूर्व सैनिकों के त्याग और सेवा को नमन करते हैं। 🇮🇳

Indian Army Enhances School Security in North #Sikkim 

The Indian Army continues its commitment to community welfare in North Sikkim.
A CCTV surveillance system has been installed at Government Junior High School, Sarchok (Lachung), to enhance safety, improve staff management and ensure effective monitoring of the school environment. 🇮🇳

भारतीय सेना द्वारा उत्तर सिक्किम में सामुदायिक कल्याण की दिशा में एक और कदम।
सरकारी जूनियर हाई स्कूल, सारचोक (लाचुंग) में सीसीटीवी निगरानी प्रणाली स्थापित की गई है, जिससे विद्यालय की सुरक्षा, स्टाफ प्रबंधन और निगरानी व्यवस्था को मजबूती मिलेगी।

⚓📰 #USNAVY UPDATE: Two Decades of Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific: Pacific Partnership 2026 Mission Begins

SAN DIEGO -- Pacific Partnership, the U.S. Navy’s largest annual maritime humanitarian and civic assistance effort conducted in the Indo-Pacific, officially began with the departure of U.S. personnel from San Diego to the mission coordinating hub in the Philippines, May 27, 2026.

The Pacific Partnership 2026 (PP26) team, led by U.S. Navy Capt. Robert C. Reyes, mission commander, and Canadian Armed Forces Col. Alain Lafrenière, deputy mission commander, will conduct mission stops in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Timor-Leste, and Vietnam.

"This year marks the 20th anniversary of Pacific Partnership, and the 22nd time embarking on this critical mission alongside our allies and partners," said Reyes. "With our unified commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific, we strengthen regional security by building host nation capacity to prepare for and overcome crises, deepen cooperation, and deliver an enduring impact across the region.”

🚨📰 #USNAVY UPDATE: USS John P. Murtha to support NASA's Artemis II mission

SAN DIEGO – Amphibious transport dock ship USS John P. Murtha (LPD 26) is slated to serve as the recovery ship for the Orion spacecraft and its crew upon their return from the historic Artemis II mission.

The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft, sending four astronauts on an approximately 10-day journey that will take them beyond the Moon. This mission will mark humanity's first crewed voyage to the vicinity of the Moon in over 50 years.

Upon completion of their mission, the Orion capsule will splash down in the Pacific Ocean, where John P. Murtha and its crew will be prepared to recover the astronauts and the spacecraft.

🚨📰 US NAVY UPDATE: Navy’s Free Barracks Wi-Fi Program Reaches Installations in Italy and Greece

The Navy’s initiative to provide free, high-speed Wi-Fi to all Navy owned-and-operated unaccompanied housing (UH) has reached 86 percent completion, with the service now available in 827 of 952 total buildings since launching last November.

The program, a partnership between Commander, Navy Installations Command (CNIC) and the Navy Exchange Service Command (NEXCOM), continued its expansion with service going live at Naval Support Activity (NSA) Naples, Naval Air Station (NAS) Sigonella, and NSA Souda Bay on April 1.
Driven by a focus on improving the quality of life and well-being of Sailors, the Wi-Fi expansion has seen rapid adoption, with 70.5 percent of residents in available buildings registered for the service as of February. A continuous survey of residents shows an 84 percent overall satisfaction rate reflecting the program’s success.
“This initiative is a direct reflection of our unwavering commitment to the well-being of our Sailors,” said Vice Adm. Scott Gray, Commander, Navy Installations Command. “Providing free, high-speed Wi-Fi is a fundamental step in improving their quality of life, ensuring they have the connectivity they need for personal and professional growth. We are dedicated to delivering the resources that support our warfighters, and this program is a testament to that promise.”

Having cleared a small area, he requested and directed the landing of two transport helicopters to evacuate the deceased and wounded. He then assisted in seizing the battalion's objective.

🚨📰⚓ #USNAVY UPDATE: Naval Research Lab Sharpens Navy’s Sights with a Domain-Centric Path for Smarter Sensing

The U.S. Naval Research Laboratory (NRL) launched a remote sensing experiment to sharpen artificial intelligence (AI) applications in hyperspectral imaging across the Department of the Navy and broader scientific community.
Hyperspectral imaging, often described as capturing “the color of color,” provides a unique spectral fingerprint for each pixel. Combined with AI, these fingerprints support powerful tools for detecting subtle material differences and observing environmental change.

“We are enhancing the efficacy of AI-driven approaches in resolving sub-pixel material compositions,” said NRL CHROMA Project Lead Katarina Doctor, Ph.D. “By methodically changing the targets and viewing them with different sensors, we can learn how an object's signature changes based on its material, the weather, and the type of sensor used to view it.”

Doctor emphasized the data’s direct application to naval missions, stating it will significantly improve our ability to detect and identify objects in crowded littoral zones. She noted that this improved hyperspectral detection is key to assessing threats, monitoring critical infrastructure, and ensuring the U.S. Navy can maintain a clear operational advantage in any coastal environment.

Doctors at Army Institute of Cardiothoracic Sciences (AICTS), #Pune have successfully treated four patients with coronary stent infection and aneurysmal dilatation of the coronary artery following PCI—an ultra-rare complication, with only about 40 cases reported worldwide. The patients, who had undergone prior treatment at civil and private hospitals across the country, were managed surgically through extraction/exclusion of the infected coronary stent aneurysm and bypass grafting distal to the affected segment, resulting in successful resolution of this complex iatrogenic complication. ASSAM RIFLES INSPIRES YOUTH BY ORGANISING INTERACTION WITH ASTROPHYSICIST DR RONALDO LAISHRAM AT KAKCHING
#AssamRifles facilitated the visit of Dr Ronaldo Laishram, an internationally acclaimed astrophysicist from Khangabok, Manipur, at Kakching Garrison on 02 June 2026 as part of its ongoing efforts to foster scientific curiosity and inspire youth. Dr Ronaldo, currently a Project (Postdoctoral) Researcher at the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan (NAOJ), recently led the discovery of the “Loktak Protocluster,” a 12.6-billion-year-old galactic structure named after Manipur’s iconic Loktak Lake. During the event, he interacted with 130 students and teachers of Assam Rifles Public School, Kakching, sharing his inspiring journey and encouraging perseverance, critical thinking and scientific inquiry. The students actively participated in an engaging question-and-answer session on astronomy, space exploration and emerging technologies. The initiative promoted scientific temper and STEM career aspirations while reaffirming Assam Rifles’ commitment to educational outreach and youth empowerment.

ASSAM RIFLES ORGANISES MYOPIA AWARENESS AND SCREENING CAMP IN PALLEL
#AssamRifles, in collaboration with Ibotombi Eye Care, Canchipur, organised a Myopia Awareness and Screening Camp at Assam Rifles Public School, Pallel Garrison, Chandel district, Manipur on 30 May 2026. The camp was conducted to commemorate the 48th Foundation Day of the ENTOD Foundation and aimed to promote preventive eye care and early detection of vision-related issues among children. A total of 143 participants, including 108 students, 20 teachers and 15 family members, attended the programme. Medical experts conducted awareness sessions on myopia, emphasising healthy visual habits, reduced screen time and regular eye examinations. Participants requiring further attention were provided professional counselling and medical guidance.

On 27 May 2026, medical staff at Assam Rifles Unit Hospital, Keithelmanbi, provided urgent treatment to a 67-year-old resident suffering from severe abdominal pain, stabilising the patient through prompt medical intervention.

The ceremony honoured 02 Officers, 58 JCOs, 105 Other Ranks and 01 Civil Staff member who are set to superannuate on 31 May 2026 after years of dedicated and selfless service to the nation.
The event witnessed the gracious presence of 105 family members from different parts of the country, making the occasion deeply emotional and memorable for the retirees. Addressing the gathering, the DG Assam Rifles expressed gratitude for the unwavering commitment, professionalism and sacrifices of the retiring personnel in safeguarding the nation and upholding the proud legacy of the Force.
The programme concluded with a Veterans Day lunch and interaction session, where veterans and serving personnel fondly shared experiences and memories, reflecting the enduring bond of brotherhood, camaraderie and esprit de corps that continues to strengthen the Assam Rifles fraternity.

ASSAM RIFLES PAYS TRIBUTE TO LATE HAV HANGPAN DADA, ASHOK CHAKRA (POSTHUMOUS)
On the occasion of the 10th Balidan Diwas of Late Hav Hangpan Dada, Ashok Chakra (Posthumous), Khonsa Battalion of #AssamRifles organised a series of commemorative events at Borduria and Khonsa, Arunachal Pradesh to honour the supreme sacrifice, courage and unwavering dedication of the Braveheart towards the nation.
As part of the commemoration, a Wreath Laying Ceremony was organised on 26 May 2026 at the memorial of Late Hav Hangpan Dada at Borduria, where officers, troops and local residents paid solemn homage to the Braveheart on his 10th Balidan Diwas.
A Bike Rally was also organised from Deomali Helipad to the Memorial of Late Hav Hangpan Dada at Borduria on 25 May 2026, aimed at inspiring patriotism and paying tribute to his valour and selfless service. A Cultural Evening was conducted at Towang Lowangdong Auditorium featuring patriotic songs, skits and a documentary screening depicting the life and sacrifice of the Braveheart. The events reflected Assam Rifles deep respect for the indomitable spirit and supreme sacrifice of one of the nation’s finest heroes.

#AssamRifles paid homage to Havildar (Late) Rithe Tamang of 5 Assam Rifles with a solemn wreath-laying ceremony at the Unit Quarter Guard in Veng Village, Churachandpur on 26 May 2026. On this day in 1955 Havildar Tamang made the supreme sacrifice during operations in Tawang district. His courage and devotion to duty continue to inspire generations. The ceremony held with full military honours saw 154 personnel pay their respects and accord a Guard of Honour. It concluded with a motivational address reinforcing the enduring ethos of “Nation Before Self” and the force’s unwavering commitment to honouring its martyrs.

ASSAM RIFLES CONTINUES SUCCESSFUL OPERATIONS ACROSS MANIPUR
#AssamRifles, in close coordination with Manipur Police and other security agencies, conducted a series of successful operations across multiple districts of Manipur between 17 and 22 May 2026, leading to the apprehension of several active cadres of proscribed outfits and recovery of a significant cache of arms, ammunition and explosives.
Joint operations carried out in Imphal West, Thoubal, Kakching, Bishnupur, Tengnoupal and Churachandpur districts resulted in the apprehension of cadres belonging to KYKL, UNLF(K), PLA and KCP-T outfits. Security forces also recovered weapons including AK-47 Rifle, SLR Rifle, SMG carbine, pistols, grenades, IEDs, ammunition, radio sets and other war-like stores.
All apprehended individuals alongwith the recovered items were handed over to the respective Police Stations for further legal action. The operations reflect the continued commitment of Assam Rifles towards maintaining peace, security and stability in the region.

DG ASSAM RIFLES VISITS ZOKHAWSANG BATTALION IN MIZORAM
Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera, AVSM, SM, DG #AssamRifles, visited the Zokhawsang Battalion of Assam Rifles in Mizoram on 24 May 2026 and reviewed the operational preparedness of the unit. RARE MEDICINAL PLANT WORTH ₹51 LAKH RECOVERED IN ASSAM RIFLES OPERATION
#AssamRifles foiled a major smuggling attempt of illegal forest produce near Zorinpui, Mizoram along the Indo-Myanmar border on 19 May 2026. A total of 150 bags of Anchiri (Paris polyphylla), valued at ₹51 lakh, were recovered after being moved via the Sekul river for loading onto trucks. Three individuals were apprehended. The seized items, vehicles, and suspects were handed over to Bungtlang Police Station and the Lawngtlai Forest Department. Anchiri, a rare and highly valuable medicinal plant, is increasingly targeted by cross-border smuggling networks due to its high demand. The operation highlights Assam Rifles’ continued efforts to curb illegal trade and protect biodiversity in the region.

MoU BETWEEN ASSAM RIFLES & PUNJAB NATIONAL BANK IN SHILLONG
#AssamRifles signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Punjab National Bank, first Indigenous Swadeshi Bank on 20 May 2026 at HQ DGAR, Laitkor, Shillong, to introduce a customised Rakshak Plus Salary Package for its serving and retired personnel. The MoU was formalised in the presence of Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera, AVSM, SM, DG Assam Rifles, alongwith Maj Gen DS Bisht SM, VSM** (Retd), Chief Defence Banking Advisor & Shri Sanjeev Bhardwaj, General Manager, Head Office, Punjab National Bank. The agreement was signed by Brig Sandip Chatterjee, SM, Brig (Personal), on behalf of DG Assam Rifles and Mr Bijender Singh, Zonal Manager Guwahati Zone, Punjab National Bank. It also incorporates a specially curated Health Insurance Scheme exclusively designed for Assam Rifles personnel, alongwith personal accident cover, permanent total disability cover and a range of other tailored financial benefits. This initiative underscores Assam Rifles continued commitment to enhancing the welfare, healthcare support and financial security of its personnel and veterans.

ASSAM RIFLES HONOURS SACRIFICES OF VETERANS AND VEER NARIS IN MANIPUR
#AssamRifles organised a solemn felicitation ceremony at Ukhrul, Manipur to honour the invaluable contributions and sacrifices of Veer Naris, widows and Assam Rifles Ex-Servicemen (ARESM) residing in the region. The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from veterans and their families, celebrating their enduring legacy and service to the nation. As a gesture of gratitude and support, financial assistance was provided to Veer Naris and widows present during the event. Essential medical aids, including wheelchairs, hearing aids, commode chairs and walking sticks, were also distributed to address the healthcare needs of the veteran community and enhance their quality of life. The initiative reflected Assam Rifles unwavering commitment towards the welfare and well-being of its extended family.

The initiative aimed at providing essential healthcare services to residents who often face limited access to medical facilities due to the challenging terrain and remoteness of the region. A total of 135 local men, women and children benefitted from the initiative.

ASSAM RIFLES ENGAGES NAGA AND KUKI COMMUNITIES TO STRENGTHEN PEACE IN TAMENGLONG

The meetings were attended by 71 participants including 12 women from Naga and Kuki communities, focused on maintaining communal harmony, preventing rumours, denying support to UG groups and ensuring cooperation with security forces. Participants were also urged to ensure unhindered movement along NH-37 and work towards long-term peace and development in the area.

WEEKLY SUMMARY: COORDINATED OPERATIONS YIELD MAJOR RECOVERIES ACROSS MANIPUR
#AssamRifles, in close coordination with Manipur Police and other security agencies, continued sustained intelligence-based operations across Manipur (03 – 09 May 2026), achieving major successes in counter-insurgency and area domination efforts.
🔹 Weapons & Ammunition Recovery:
Security forces recovered a significant cache of arms and war-like stores, including:
• 01 x SMG Carbine
• 04 x Bolt Action Rifles
• 01 x 9mm Pistol
• 01 x Single Barrel 12 Bore Gun
• Live ammunition and empty cases
• 01 x Radio Set

🔹 Operational Highlights:
• Operation New Heaven conducted jointly by Assam Rifles, BSF, and Manipur Police in Ukhrul District along NH-202 axis
• 16 bunkers destroyed during area domination and combing operations aimed at restoring regional stability
• Sustained operations disrupted insurgent movement and unlawful activities in vulnerable areas

🔹 Apprehensions:
A series of intelligence-led joint operations resulted in the apprehension of active cadres belonging to:
• KYKL
• KCP (PSC)
• PREPAK (PRO)
• KYKL (SOREPA)
• KCP (Apunba)

Recoveries from apprehended cadres included mobile phones, SIM cards, Aadhaar cards, camouflage uniforms, and cash amounting to ₹6.81 lakhs.

🔹 Key Achievement:
On 10 May 2026, a Self-Styled Sergeant Major of KCP (Apunba) serving as a fighting commander was apprehended in Thoubal District during a coordinated operation with Kakching Commandos and Manipur Police.

All apprehended individuals and recovered items have been handed over to the concerned police stations for further legal proceedings.

text:
ASSAM RIFLES HONOURS VETERANS AND VEER NARIS AT JAIPUR EX-SERVICEMEN RALLY
#AssamRifles conducted an Ex-Servicemen Rally at BM Birla Auditorium, Jaipur on 10 May 2026 under HQ DGAR, reaffirming its commitment towards the welfare of veterans, Veer Naris and their families.
The event was presided over by Maj Gen Jai Singh Bainsla, SM, Additional Director General, Assam Rifles. More than 700 Ex-servicemen from Haryana and Rajasthan attended the event, reflecting their strong bond with the force. Eight Veer Naris and six gallantry awardees were felicitated for their sacrifice and distinguished service.
Welfare activities were also organised, including help desks for pension issues, ECHS facilities, grievance redressal, documentation support, and awareness on welfare schemes. Medical consultation and rehabilitation assistance were also provided.
As part of this initiative, Assam Rifles teams have so far visited 44 locations across 17 states and interacted with a total of 8,992 veterans, Veer Naris and dependents. In addition, 66 bedridden veterans and NOKs have been personally visited and assisted as part of the outreach efforts. Financial assistance is also being provided in deserving cases on a case-to-case basis.

ASSAM RIFLES FOILS ILLEGAL ARMS NETWORK IN CACHAR, TWO APPREHENDED
#AssamRifles, along with representatives of FID and Cachar Police based on specific intelligence inputs from FID, ARFIU and own sources, launched a joint operation in general area Tarapur, Cachar on 06 May 2026. During the operation, the team recovered one US made pistol, one magazine, five rounds of 9 mm ammunition and one Chinese grenade. Two individuals, including one male and one female, were apprehended in connection with the recovery. The apprehended individuals along with the recovered items were handed over to Cachar Police for further investigation. On request of the police, the recovered grenade was safely destroyed by the unit’s IED/Bomb Disposal qualified team.

ASSAM RIFLES RECOVERS HUGE CACHE OF ARMS & AMMUNITION IN MANIPUR
#AssamRifles successfully recovered a huge cache of arms and ammunition on 07 May 2026 from the Maranmei Hill Range, Senapati, Manipur, during a well-planned intelligence-based operation. The operation was launched by 16 Assam Rifles based on inputs from ARFIU and 3 CIB, further corroborated by own sources, reflecting the force’s high operational preparedness and sustained efforts to curb insurgent activities in the region.
🔹 Recoveries included:
• 01 x AK-47 Rifle with magazine
• 01 x MP-5 Rifle with magazine
• 01 x .303 Rifle with magazine
• 02 x .22 Rifles with magazines
• 04 x locally made Bolt Action Rifles
• 03 x .32 Pistols with magazines
• 02 x .22 Pistols with magazines
• 01 x locally made Shotgun

🔹 Ammunition recovered:
• 04 rounds of 5.56 mm ammunition
• 15 rounds of 9 mm ammunition
• 20 rounds of .303 ammunition
• 20 rounds of .32 ammunition
• 04 rounds of Sniper Ball 7.62×54 mm ammunition
• 16 rounds of 12 Bore ammunition
• Additional empty ammunition cases and rounds

The recovery of such a substantial cache is a significant step towards disrupting the supply chain of illegal weapons to insurgent groups and reinforces Assam Rifles’ commitment to maintaining peace and security in the Northeast.

HQ DGAR OUTREACH TEAM VISITS VEER NARI & BEDRIDDEN AR VETERAN AT REWARI, HARYANA
#AssamRifles, as part of its ongoing Outreach Drive, visited two esteemed members of the Assam Rifles fraternity at Rewari, Haryana on 29 Apr 2026. The team first met Smt Sushil, wife of Martyr Rfn (GD) Vijender Singh of 34 AR, who made the supreme sacrifice in an IED blast at Thoubal on 10 Jul 2005 while on ROP duty. The team conveyed heartfelt respects and reaffirmed continued support for the family’s welfare. The team also visited WO (RM) Ramanand (Retd), 65 years, of 38 AR, who has been bedridden for the past four years due to a stroke causing left-side paralysis. The team interacted with the veteran and his family, expressing concern and assuring all possible assistance. Both families conveyed their sincere gratitude to DGAR and the Outreach Team for their care, support, and continued commitment towards the welfare of Ex-Servicemen, Veer Naris, and their families.

WEEKLY OPERATION SUMMARY: JOINT OPERATIONS DELIVER STRONG BLOW TO INSURGENT NETWORKS IN MANIPUR
#AssamRifles, in close coordination with Manipur Police, continued proactive operations across the state, achieving key successes in counter-insurgency and border security.

Apprehensions:
• 01 PREPAK (PRO) cadre apprehended in Kakching District
• 02 insurgent cadres linked to PREPAK (PRO) and PLA intercepted along the Indo-Myanmar Border in Tengnoupal
• 01 individual apprehended in Ukhrul District while attempting to move ₹36 lakhs across the border

Weapons & Explosives Recovery:
Security forces recovered:
• 01 AK-47 rifle with magazine
• 01 carbine with magazine
• 04 Single Bore Rifles
• 11 Pompi (Improvised mortars) & bombs
• 03 grenades with detonator
• 04 Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs) (destroyed in situ)
• Radio communication sets with chargers

Operational Highlights:
• Successful border ambush operations thwarted infiltration attempts
• Major weapons cache busted in Chandel District
• Sustained area domination patrols along the Indo-Myanmar Border

All apprehended individuals and recovered items have been handed over to the Manipur Police for further legal proceedings.

ASSAM RIFLES OUTREACH PROGRAMME AT PALAMPUR HIMACHAL PRADESH ON 26 APRIL
#AssamRifles conducted an outreach programme at Palampur on 26 April 2026. The event witnessed participation of approximately 600 attendees, including ARESM, Veer Naris and Next of Kin (NOK) from Himachal Pradesh and Punjab, reflecting the enduring bond between the force and its extended family.
During the programme, Veer Naris and gallantry awardees were felicitated by Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera AVSM, SM Director General Assam Rifles, in recognition to their sacrifice and exemplary service. As part of the welfare initiatives wheel chairs, hearing aids, walking stick and assistance devices were also distributed to the veterans, veer naris and gallantry awardees.
To address the grievances and concerns of ex-servicemen, dedicated stalls were set up by ARESA, ARGIS and Records branches to facilitate resolution of grievances and provide assistance on various service-related matters. Banking support was extended through stalls established by Axis Bank and State Bank of India, while ECHS empanelled hospitals also participated to offer medical guidance and support services to the attendees.
The event concluded with refreshments and lunch for all participants, fostering camaraderie and reaffirming Assam Rifles’ steadfast commitment towards the welfare of its veterans and their families.

MoU BETWEEN ASSAM RIFLES & AXIS BANK AT SHILLONG
#AssamRifles signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with #AxisBank on 23 Apr 2026 at HQ DGAR, Laitkor, Shillong, to introduce a customised Corporate Salary Package for its serving and retired personnel. The MoU was formalised in the presence of Maj Gen Jai Singh Bainsla, SM, ADG Assam Rifles, on behalf of Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera, AVSM, SM, DG Assam Rifles, along with Ms. Satpreet Chelawat, Executive Vice President and Business Head – Corporate Salary Business, Axis Bank.

It also incorporates a specially curated health insurance scheme exclusively designed for Assam Rifles personnel, along with personal accident cover, permanent total disability cover and a range of other tailored financial benefits. This initiative underscores Assam Rifles’ continued commitment to enhancing the welfare, healthcare support and financial security of its personnel and veterans.

#AssamRifles provided swift emergency assistance on 20 April 2026 following a major fire at the residence of Mr WS Emannuel in Akaphe, Chakpikarong, Manipur. ASSAM RIFLES RECOVER ARMS CACHE AND APPREHEND INSURGENT CADRES IN MANIPUR
#AssamRifles launched a search operation in Kamjong District on the intervening night of 11–12 April 2026, based on specific intelligence regarding the movement of war-like stores and the establishment of caches along the Indo-Myanmar Border. Using metal detectors and an explosive detection dog, troops identified a suspicious site and uncovered a concealed cache containing a substantial quantity of arms, ammunition, explosives, and other war-like stores. All recovered items were subsequently handed over to the concerned authorities for further investigation.
In a series of coordinated joint operations, Assam Rifles, in collaboration with the Territorial Army and state police commandos, apprehended three insurgent cadres in Thoubal, Tengnoupal, and Kakching districts between 16 and 19 April 2026. The individuals were identified as active members of PREPAK (Pro) and KYKL (SOREPA) and were found to have undergone training in Myanmar. Security forces recovered mobile phones and foreign currency from their possession. All apprehended individuals, along with the recovered items, were handed over to the respective police authorities for further legal action and investigation.

#AssamRifles organised a motivational lecture for troops at Chieswema Garrison, Kohima District, Nagaland on 11 April 2026, with the aim of enhancing morale, reinforcing professional ethos and strengthening operational motivation among personnel. The session was delivered by Colonel R K Sharma, KC, SC, SM (Retd), a highly decorated veteran of the Indian Army and a former officer of Assam Rifles. Drawing from his extensive operational experience, he shared valuable insights from his participation in major operations including Op Vijay, Op Parakram, Op Bajrang, Op Hifazat and Op Rakshak. He emphasised leadership under challenging conditions, mental resilience, discipline and teamwork as key factors in operational success.

The training included comprehensive inputs on map reading, weapon handling and fieldcraft, alongwith practical exposure to firing positions and basic knowledge of arms. Cadets were further imparted hands-on training on camp layout and establishment including siting of essential components such as kote, magazine and other key installations.

ASSAM RIFLES WOMEN’S FOOTBALL TEAM CROWNED CHAMPIONS AT 74TH B N MULLICK MEMORIAL ALL INDIA POLICE FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP 2025–26
#AssamRifles Women’s Football Team clinched the championship at the 74th B N Mullick Memorial All India Police Football Championship 2025–26 held in Hyderabad from 23 March to 05 April 2026. In a closely contested final on 04 April, they defeated Odisha Police 1–0 to lift the trophy, remaining unbeaten throughout the tournament and showcasing exceptional skill, discipline and teamwork. This achievement reflects the Assam Rifles’ strong commitment to promoting sports and empowering women athletes. Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera, AVSM, SM, Director General Assam Rifles, congratulated the team for their outstanding achievement, praising their dedication and performance that brought pride and honour to the force.

MAJOR DRUG BUST: ASSAM RECOVER HEROIN WORTH RS 2.10 CRORE IN SILCHAR
Srikona Battalion of #AssamRifles, in coordination with Cachar Police, carried out joint operation in general area Meharpur, Silchar, Assam on 03 April 2026. During the operation, 30 soap cases of heroin weighing approximately 349 grams with an estimated market value of Rs 2.10 crore was recovered and three individuals were apprehended in connection with the recovery. The recovered contraband along with the apprehended individuals has been handed over to Cachar Police for further investigation.

ASSAM RIFLES MARKS GOOD FRIDAY WITH HUMANITARIAN OUTREACH ACROSS MANIPUR
Srikona Battalion of #AssamRifles, on the occasion of Good Friday on 03 April 2026, undertook a humanitarian outreach initiative across multiple remote locations in Manipur. Essential items were distributed to villagers in New Kaiphundai (Tamenglong District), Nungba (Noney District), Borobekra, and Jiribam. At Nungba, the initiative was carried out by Nungba COB at St John Catholic Church, Nungba, where essential supplies were provided to numerous families. The Good Friday event at St John Catholic Church witnessed participation of approximately 250 members of the local community, reflecting strong civil-military bonding and mutual trust.

श्रीकोना बटालियन, असम राइफल्स ने 03 अप्रैल 2026 को गुड फ्राइडे के अवसर पर मणिपुर के विभिन्न दूरदराज क्षेत्रों में एक मानवीय सहायता पहल संचालित की। इस दौरान न्यू कैफुंडई (तमेंगलॉंग जिला), नुंगबा (नोने जिला), बोराबेक्रा और जिरीबाम के ग्रामीणों को आवश्यक सामग्री वितरित की गई।
नुंगबा में यह पहल नुंगबा COB द्वारा सेंट जॉन कैथोलिक चर्च, नुंगबा में आयोजित की गई, जहाँ अनेक परिवारों को आवश्यक सामग्री प्रदान की गई। सेंट जॉन कैथोलिक चर्च में आयोजित गुड फ्राइडे कार्यक्रम में स्थानीय समुदाय के लगभग 250 लोगों ने भाग लिया, जो सशक्त नागरिक-सैन्य संबंधों और आपसी विश्वास को दर्शाता है।

text:
ASSAM RIFLES FACILITATES DIGNIFIED WREATH LAYING CEREMONY AT KOHIMA
Shri Nand Kishor Yadav, Hon’ble Governor of Nagaland, visited Kohima War Cemetery on 02 Apr 2026 and laid a wreath conducted by #AssamRifles to pay solemn tribute to the brave soldiers who made the supreme sacrifice during the Battle of Kohima. Following the ceremony, Assam Rifles provided a detailed briefing on its historical significance. The briefing highlighted the pivotal role of the Battle of Kohima, often referred to as the “Stalingrad of the East,” in altering the course of World War II. The visit underscored the continued commitment of the Assam Rifles not only towards safeguarding the nation but also in preserving its rich military heritage and upholding the traditions of honour and remembrance for the brave soldiers.
नागालैंड के माननीय राज्यपाल श्री नंद किशोर यादव ने 02 अप्रैल2026 को कोहिमा वॉर सेमेट्री का दौरा किया और असम राइफल्स द्वारा आयोजित समारोह में कोहिमा की लड़ाई के दौरान सर्वोच्च बलिदान देने वाले वीर सैनिकों को श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित की।
समारोह के पश्चात असम राइफल्स द्वारा इसके ऐतिहासिक महत्व पर विस्तृत जानकारी दी गई। इस ब्रीफिंग में कोहिमा की लड़ाई की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका को रेखांकित किया गया, जिसे अक्सर “पूर्व का स्टालिनग्राद” कहा जाता है, जिसने द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध की दिशा बदलने में अहम योगदान दिया।
यह दौरा इस बात को भी दर्शाता है कि असम राइफल्स न केवल राष्ट्र की सुरक्षा के प्रति प्रतिबद्ध है, बल्कि अपनी समृद्ध सैन्य विरासत के संरक्षण तथा वीर सैनिकों के सम्मान और स्मरण की परंपराओं को बनाए रखने के लिए भी समर्पित है।

#AssamRifles Women’s Football Team continued their brilliant performance in the 74th BN Mullick All India Police Football Championship 2025–26 being held at Hyderabad, Telangana and have successfully advanced into the finals of the championship. Students of Assam Rifles Public School also enthralled the audience with their vibrant performance.
The event highlighted unity in diversity and celebrated the enduring traditions and spirit of the Assam Rifles.

Assam Rifles, in collaboration with REACHA and supported by the IIFL Foundation under its Corporate Social Responsibility initiative, successfully concluded the third batch of the Skill Development Training Programme titled “Right Skill, Bright Future” at Pallel Garrison on 18 March 2026.
In total, 146 youth have been trained across three batches, with 91 successfully placed, underscoring the programme’s tangible impact on employment generation and skill development in Manipur. As a result of this training, 35 participants from Batch III secured employment in leading organisations such as Le Meridien, Navi Mumbai; Sterling Holidays across multiple locations; and Taj Vivanta, Bhubaneswar.

*HON’BLE GOVERNOR OF MANIPUR LAYS WREATH IN HONOUR OF MAJ RALENGNAO “BOB” KHATHING, MC, MBE*
Imphal, 18 March 2026: Assam Rifles organised a Wreath Laying Ceremony at Valley View, Mantripukhri, Imphal to pay tribute to Maj Ralengnao “Bob Khathing”, MC, MBE (1912–1990), an illustrious yet unsung hero whose legacy continues to inspire generations. The ceremony was graced by Shri Ajay Kumar Bhalla, Hon’ble Governor of Manipur, as the Chief Guest. The event witnessed the presence of the Inspector General Assam Rifles (South), General Officer Commanding, 57 Mountain Division, senior military officials, dignitaries, members of the Khathing family, local community leaders and troops, totalling over 300 attendees.
A significant highlight of the occasion was the release of the 2nd Edition of the Coffee Table Book, the biography of Maj Bob Khathing, by the Hon’ble Governor of Manipur. Shri John S.R. Khathing, IRS (Retd), son of Maj Bob Khathing, also spoke on the life and values of his father, urging the younger generation to uphold integrity and commitment in all walks of life.

ASSAM RIFLES EXTENDS SUPPORT TO MOBILITY IMPAIRED VETERAN IN UTTARAKHAND
Demonstrating its unwavering commitment to the welfare of veterans, #AssamRifles extended a helping hand to Rfn Bhagwant Singh an Ex-Serviceman from Almora who lost both his legs in 2020 due to Peripheral Artery Disease. Responding to his request for assistance to improve mobility, Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera, AVSM, SM, Director General Assam Rifles, facilitated the provision of a specially designed three-wheeler scooty, which was formally handed over on 14 March 2026.
Deeply moved by the gesture, Rfn Bhagwant Singh expressed heartfelt gratitude, describing it as a “valuable gift” that will greatly improve his daily life. Overwhelmed with emotion, he shared, “I feel like I’ve got my legs back.” The initiative reflects Assam Rifles’ enduring commitment to honouring and supporting its veterans, ensuring that those who once served the nation with dedication continue to receive care, dignity and respect.

#AssamRifles inaugurated the Waikhong Sports Championship in Kakching District, Manipur on 13 March 2026. Senior Officials of Assam Rifles, together with troops, joined the community in celebrating the conclusion of the tournament, which ran from 3 to 13 March at the Waikhong football ground. Eight youth club teams from Waikhong competed in spirited matches that brought the village together, showcasing discipline, teamwork and sportsmanship. The final match on 13 March was followed by an award ceremony where winners and runners-up were honoured with trophies, medals and tracksuits. To further strengthen grassroots athletics, local youth clubs were also provided with professional football and volleyball gear.

ASSAM RIFLES SEIZES FOREIGN ORIGIN CIGARETTES WORTH ₹39 LAKHS FROM CHAMPHAI, MIZORAM
#AssamRifles in a joint operation with Champhai Police launched a thorough search operation on 14 March 2026 in the general area Jail Veng, Champhai District, Mizoram. During the course of the detailed search of targeted area, the team recovered a total of 30 cases of foreign-origin cigarettes, comprising 06 cases of XSO Black Fruits Apple Mint Cigarettes, 17 cases of XSO Black Fruits Strawberry Cigarettes, 02 cases of ORIS Silver Cigarettes and 05 cases of Farstar Cigarettes, valued at approximately ₹39 Lakhs. Also, two individuals namely Mr R Lalnunhlima and Mr Benzamin LN Liana were also apprehended.

ASSAM RIFLES SEIZES HEROIN WORTH ₹3.5 CRORE IN ASSAM
#AssamRifles in a joint operation with #CacharPolice, apprehended five individuals and seized heroin worth approximately ₹3.5 crore in Cachar district, Assam on 07 March 2026. The operation was launched based on specific intelligence regarding narcotics trafficking in the region. Acting on the inputs, the joint team intercepted the suspects at Burunga village near Kalain while they were transporting the contraband with plans to move it towards Meghalaya. Two vehicles used for transporting the drugs and several mobile phones were also seized. The apprehended individuals, alongwith the recovered items, were handed over to Cachar Police for further investigation and legal proceedings.

ASSAM RIFLES NATIONAL INTEGRATION TOUR PARTICIPANTS EXPERIENCE CULTURAL, SCIENTIFIC AND URBAN LANDMARKS IN KERALA AND MUMBAI
#AssamRifles organised a National Integration Tour (NIT) for 24 youths from Manipur representing the Kuki, Meitei, Pangal and Naga communities to promote national unity and cultural understanding. During the tour, the participants visited Thiruvananthapuram, exploring the Napier Museum, Thiruvananthapuram Zoo and Sri Chitra Art Gallery, and interacted with the Hon’ble Governor of Kerala at Raj Bhavan. They also visited the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, Pangode Military Station, Priyadarshini Planetarium and Kanyakumari. The group later travelled to Mumbai, where they visited landmarks including the Gateway of India, Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus, Marine Drive, Juhu Beach and the Bandra–Worli Sea Link, along with institutions such as the Nehru Science Centre, Bombay Stock Exchange, Reserve Bank of India and Wankhede Stadium. The tour provided valuable exposure to India’s diverse culture, heritage and development, strengthening the spirit of national integration among the youth.

ASSAM RIFLES – USI ANNUAL SEMINAR HELD IN NEW DELHI
The Assam Rifles – United Service Institution of India (USI) Annual Seminar was held at the Maj Gen Samir Sinha Auditorium, USI, New Delhi on 10 March 2026 on the theme “Security Challenges to the North East: Assessment & Way Forward.” The seminar was graced by Lt Gen Rajiv Ghai, SYSM, UYSM, AVSM, SM***, Deputy Chief of Army Staff (Strategy) as the Chief Guest, who delivered the keynote address on the evolving security dynamics of the North Eastern Region. Lt Gen Vikas Lakhera, AVSM, SM, Director General Assam Rifles and Vice Admiral Sanjay J Singh, SYSM, PVSM, AVSM, NM (Retd), Director USI also shared insightful perspectives on emerging security challenges and the need for a comprehensive approach to ensure long-term peace and stability in the region. Senior officers of the Indian Army and Assam Rifles, members of academia, policy practitioners and media representatives participated in meaningful deliberations on border management, regional developments and the evolving information landscape impacting security in the North East. As the “Sentinels of the North East” and “Friends of the Hill People,” Assam Rifles continues to play a pivotal role in maintaining peace, stability and development in the region.

🔥 𝗙𝗥𝗢𝗠 𝗖𝗜𝗩𝗜𝗟𝗜𝗔𝗡𝗦 𝗧𝗢 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗧-𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗗𝗬 𝗪𝗔𝗥𝗥𝗜𝗢𝗥𝗦! 🔥
The thunder of marching boots echoed across Bareilly as Batch 07/25 of #Agniveers crossed the defining threshold from youth to guardians of the Nation. 🇮🇳⚔️
After 24 weeks of relentless training, grit, sacrifice and transformation, these young warriors stood tall at the Passing Out Parade of the Jat Regimental Centre—ready to defend India’s honour, sovereignty and future.
Reviewed by Brig Harjit Prit Pal Singh, VSM, Commandant, the Agniveers were reminded of the timeless creed of the Jat Regiment — “Naam, Namak aur Nishan.”
❤️ The most powerful moment wasn't on the parade ground alone—it was in the eyes of proud parents who witnessed their sons transform into soldiers of India.
Forged in fire. Bound by honour. Driven by duty.
A new generation of warriors marches forward with one pledge:
🇮🇳 NATION FIRST. ALWAYS.

🔥 𝗔𝗚𝗡𝗜𝗩𝗘𝗘𝗥 𝗦𝗘 𝗔𝗚𝗡𝗜𝗣𝗔𝗧𝗛, 𝗔𝗕 𝗥𝗔𝗦𝗛𝗧𝗥 𝗞𝗜 𝗥𝗔𝗞𝗦𝗛𝗔 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗔𝗡𝗞𝗔𝗟𝗣! 🔥
बरेली की धरती आज गर्व, अनुशासन और राष्ट्रभक्ति के अद्भुत संगम की साक्षी बनी। 🇮🇳⚔️
24 सप्ताह के कठोर सैन्य प्रशिक्षण, पसीने, संघर्ष और आत्मपरिवर्तन के बाद #Agniveer बैच 07/25 ने जाट रेजिमेंटल सेंटर की भव्य Passing Out Parade में सैनिक जीवन की पहली निर्णायक दहलीज़ पार की।
ब्रिगेडियर हरजीत प्रीत पाल सिंह, VSM, कमांडेंट ने नवसैनिकों को जाट रेजिमेंट की गौरवशाली परंपरा—“नाम, नमक और निशान”—को जीवनभर सर्वोपरि रखने का संदेश दिया।
❤️ सबसे भावुक दृश्य परेड मैदान नहीं था, बल्कि उन माता-पिता की आँखें थीं जिनके सामने उनके बेटे राष्ट्ररक्षक बनकर खड़े थे।
अग्नि में तपे। कर्तव्य से जुड़े। सम्मान के लिए समर्पित।
ये केवल सैनिक नहीं— ये भारत के भविष्य के प्रहरी हैं।
🇮🇳 राष्ट्र प्रथम, सदैव प्रथम!

Not every classroom has walls. Some rise above 15,000 ft. 🏔️🇮🇳
Lt Gen DG Misra AVSM, #GOC #UttarBharat flagged off the powerful #SeemaDarshan Expedition with SSJ University — where India’s future leaders march shoulder-to-shoulder with the guardians of the Himalayas. ⚔️
20 young minds from #MilitaryStudies & #NCC are now traversing the rugged frontiers of Pithoragarh, Dharchula, Gunji, Navidang, Om Parvat, Kalapani & Adi Kailash.
This is not tourism. This is a frontline awakening. 🔥
From witnessing border infrastructure and operational preparedness to absorbing the raw spirit of sacrifice, resilience and राष्ट्र प्रथम — these students are experiencing the heartbeat of India’s last villages and first defenders.
The border is not the edge of India. It is where India stands tallest. 🇮🇳
ये सिर्फ़ एक यात्रा नहीं… ये भारत की सीमाओं को महसूस करने, सैनिकों के साहस को समझने और राष्ट्रभक्ति को जीने का अभियान है। 🇮🇳🏔️
Lt Gen DG Misra AVSM, #GOC #UttarBharat ने SSJ University के साथ #SeemaDarshan Expedition को हरी झंडी दिखाई। ⚔️
#MilitaryStudies के छात्रों और समर्पित #NCC कैडेट्स सहित 20 युवाओं की टीम अब पिथौरागढ़, धारचूला, गुंजी, नाभीढांग, ओम पर्वत, कालापानी और आदि कैलाश की दुर्गम सीमाओं पर भारत की असली ताकत को करीब से देख रही है।
जहाँ सड़कें खत्म होती हैं… वहीं से भारतीय सेना का संकल्प शुरू होता है। 🔥
ये युवा अब सिर्फ़ किताबों से नहीं, बल्कि हिमालय की ऊँचाइयों, सीमाओं की चुनौतियों और सैनिकों के अदम्य साहस से सीखेंगे।
सीमा सिर्फ़ एक रेखा नहीं — यह भारत का स्वाभिमान है। 🇮🇳

Strength isn’t always seen on the battlefield. Sometimes, it’s found in the silent sacrifices, sleepless nights and endless love of a mother raising a Special Child. ❤️
This #MothersDay, #PanchshulGunners stood beside the extraordinary mothers of Asha School Bareilly — women who fight every single day with courage in their hearts and hope in their eyes. 🇮🇳✨
The Special Ones lit up every soul with emotional performances, laughter and priceless smiles. 🎂🌸

सीमा पर सैनिक देश बचाते हैं…
लेकिन घरों में माँएँ पूरी दुनिया सँभालती हैं। ❤️🇮🇳
#MothersDay पर #PanchshulGunners ने आशा स्कूल, बरेली की उन अद्भुत माँओं को सम्मान दिया, जो अपने Special Ones के लिए हर दिन संघर्ष, त्याग और प्रेम की मिसाल बनती हैं। 🌸✨
बच्चों की भावुक प्रस्तुतियों, मुस्कानों और माँ-बच्चे के अटूट रिश्ते ने हर आँख नम कर दी। 🎂💫

हर Special Child के पीछे खड़ी होती है एक अडिग माँ… और वही असली शक्ति है। 🇮🇳✨
माँ सिर्फ जन्म नहीं देती…
वह हौसला देती है, लड़ना सिखाती है और हर दर्द में मुस्कुराना सिखाती है। ❤️

🔥 FRONTLINE HEROES. HEARTLINE HUMANITY. 🔥

While the world watched traditions, the Indian Army delivered LIFE.
In the far-flung heights of Saloor–Dungra, as #RammanFestival pulsed with ancient rhythm—Ibex Warriors moved beyond duty. They didn’t just guard borders… they healed lives.
A Medical Camp in one of the toughest terrains—bringing critical care where roads end and hope begins.
This isn’t routine. This is TRUST forged in the Himalayas.
This is POWER with PURPOSE.
This is SOLDIERS who serve beyond the battlefield. 🇮🇳
🏥 Care at the edge of the nation
🤝 Bonds stronger than borders
🌄 Humanity in uniform
From protecting land to protecting lives—THIS is India’s strength.

🔥 सीमा पर शक्ति, दिल में संवेदना! 🔥

कठिनतम हिमालयी क्षेत्र में मेडिकल कैंप—जहाँ पहुँच नहीं, वहाँ उपचार पहुँचा।
ये ड्यूटी नहीं… ये भरोसे की नींव है।
ये ताकत नहीं… ये सेवा की पराकाष्ठा है।
ये सैनिक नहीं… ये जीवन रक्षक हैं। 🇮🇳
🏥 जहाँ ज़रूरत, वहाँ सेना
🤝 सरहद से मजबूत रिश्ते
🌄 वर्दी में इंसानियत
धरती की रक्षा से आगे—ज़िंदगियों की हिफाज़त, यही है भारत की असली ताकत!

text:
🏔️ FROM HIMALAYAS RISE CHAMPIONS | DEV BHOOMI CHALLENGE 2.0

The Surya Devbhoomi Challenge 2.0 concluded in a spectacular Grand Finale at HNBGU Srinagar, celebrating courage, endurance and the unstoppable human spirit. 🔥
Against the towering Himalayas, participants pushed limits, conquered fear and proved that true victory is forged through साहस, संकल्प and discipline.
More than a competition, this challenge has become a movement of resilience, adventure and nation-building, inspiring youth to embrace the ethos of Nation First. 🇮🇳
Graced by Hon’ble CM Pushkar Singh Dhami and Lt Gen Anindya Sengupta, GOC-in-C Central Command, the ceremony honoured champions who rose above the challenge and etched their names in Devbhoomi’s legacy. 🏆
From the sacred mountains emerges a powerful message—
When courage meets purpose, legends are born. ⛰️🔥

🏔️ हिमालय से उठे विजेता | देवभूमि चैलेंज 2.0

सूर्य देवभूमि चैलेंज 2.0 का भव्य समापन HNBGU श्रीनगर में हुआ—जहाँ साहस, धैर्य और अटूट संकल्प का अद्भुत उत्सव देखने को मिला। 🔥
हिमालय की विशाल चुनौतियों के बीच प्रतिभागियों ने अपनी सीमाएँ तोड़ीं और साबित किया कि विजय उसी की होती है जिसमें साहस, संकल्प और अनुशासन हो।
यह सिर्फ प्रतियोगिता नहीं, बल्कि युवा शक्ति को राष्ट्र निर्माण, रोमांच और आत्मबल की ओर प्रेरित करने वाला आंदोलन बन चुका है। 🇮🇳
इस गौरवपूर्ण अवसर पर माननीय मुख्यमंत्री पुष्कर सिंह धामी और लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल अनिंद्य सेनगुप्ता, GOC-in-C सेंट्रल कमांड की गरिमामयी उपस्थिति ने समारोह को और भव्य बना दिया। 🏆
देवभूमि की पवित्र धरती से उठी यह पुकार—
जब इरादे हिमालय जितने ऊँचे हों, तो इतिहास बनता है। ⛰️🔥

text:
💪 “Strong Families, Strong Forces!”

Health is strength—and strength begins at home. 🏥✨
At Babugarh, #AWWA organised a powerful wellness outreach bringing together 72 ladies of Offrs, JCOs, OR & CDEs for awareness and care.
Doctors from Devnandini Hospital, Hapur conducted medical check-ups & bone density screening, while sessions on immunisation, nutrition & healthy living empowered families to stay battle-ready beyond the battlefield.
Because when Army families thrive, the nation stands stronger. 🇮🇳

💪 “स्वस्थ परिवार, सशक्त सेना!”

ताकत सिर्फ रणभूमि में नहीं—घर से शुरू होती है। 🏥✨
बाबूगढ़ में #AWWA द्वारा आयोजित स्वास्थ्य जागरूकता अभियान में 72 अधिकारी, जेसीओ, जवान व सीडीई परिवारों की महिलाओं ने भाग लेकर स्वास्थ्य के प्रति संकल्प लिया।
Devnandini Hospital, Hapur की टीम ने मेडिकल चेक-अप व बोन डेंसिटी स्क्रीनिंग की, जबकि सत्रों में टीकाकरण, पोषण और स्वस्थ जीवनशैली पर मार्गदर्शन दिया।
जब सेना के परिवार स्वस्थ होते हैं, तभी राष्ट्र और मजबूत बनता है। 🇮🇳

text:
🔥 From Classroom to Command: A Call to Serve the Nation!

In a power-packed interaction at Indian Veterinary Research Institute, Bareilly, Brig Ajay Kumar, Brig RVS Central Command ignited young minds with a powerful message — your veterinary skills can defend the nation too! 🇮🇳🐎
Sharing real-world experiences from the Remount Veterinary Corps (RVC), he unveiled how science, courage and service come together on the frontlines. From managing elite military animals to supporting operational readiness, the Corps stands where compassion meets combat support.
Students engaged with curiosity, asked sharp questions, and walked away inspired to turn passion into patriotic service. The session left the hall charged with purpose, pride and possibility.

🔥 जब ज्ञान मिला राष्ट्रसेवा के संकल्प से!

Indian Veterinary Research Institute, Bareilly में आयोजित एक प्रेरक संवाद में Brig Ajay Kumar, Brig RVS Central Command ने युवाओं को एक सशक्त संदेश दिया — आपकी पशु चिकित्सा विशेषज्ञता भी राष्ट्र की सुरक्षा में योगदान दे सकती है! 🇮🇳🐎
उन्होंने Remount Veterinary Corps (RVC) की भूमिका, चुनौतियों और गौरवशाली परंपराओं को साझा करते हुए बताया कि कैसे विज्ञान, समर्पण और साहस मिलकर सेना की ताकत को मजबूत करते हैं।
छात्रों ने उत्साहपूर्वक प्रश्न पूछे, मार्गदर्शन प्राप्त किया और राष्ट्रसेवा के नए आयामों से परिचित हुए। यह सत्र केवल करियर मार्गदर्शन नहीं, बल्कि देशभक्ति और प्रेरणा की एक शक्तिशाली चिंगारी बन गया।

🔥 113 KM. Himalayan Heights. One Unbreakable Spirit. 🏔️💪

The Surya Devbhoomi Challenge – 2nd Edition roars to life in the lap of the mighty Himalayas! 🇮🇳
Flagged off by Lt Gen DG Misra, AVSM, GOC Uttar Bharat, this ultra marathon is not just a race — it’s a test of courage, endurance and indomitable will.
From Helang to Ukimath, runners now take on 113 km of treacherous terrain, steep climbs and unforgiving mountain trails. Every stride echoes the spirit of adventure, revival of ancient Himalayan routes and the unifying power of the Indian Army.
Here, fatigue meets determination…
Pain meets purpose…
And the mountains witness legends in the making. 🏃‍♂️🔥
To every challenger on the trail — push beyond limits. The finish line awaits your grit.
Let the Himalayas hear your roar! 🇮🇳🏔️

🔥 113 किमी… हिमालय की ऊँचाइयाँ… और अदम्य जज़्बा! 🏔️💪

सूर्य देवभूमि चैलेंज – द्वितीय संस्करण आज हिमालय की गोद में दमदार शुरुआत के साथ प्रारम्भ हुआ। 🇮🇳
इस अल्ट्रा मैराथन को लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल डीजी मिश्रा, AVSM, GOC उत्तर भारत ने हेलंग से हरी झंडी दिखाकर रवाना किया।
हेलंग से उखीमठ तक 113 किमी का यह मार्ग सिर्फ दूरी नहीं, बल्कि कठिन पर्वतीय चढ़ाइयों, दुर्गम रास्तों और अटूट संकल्प की परीक्षा है।
हर कदम में रोमांच है…
हर सांस में साहस है…
और हर धड़कन में भारत की एकता की शक्ति। 🇮🇳
यह दौड़ केवल प्रतिस्पर्धा नहीं — देवभूमि की विरासत, साहस और राष्ट्रीय एकता का उत्सव है।
सभी धावकों को शुभकामनाएँ —
मंज़िल आपका इंतज़ार कर रही है। हौसला बुलंद रखें! 🏃‍♂️🔥

text:
🚨 Redefining Battlefield Care! 🛡️⚕️

Modern wars demand smarter, faster and tech-driven healing on the frontlines.
153 Medical Officers of the Senior Medical Officers Command Course & Medical Officers Basic Course visited the Saidpur Brigade of #GoldenKeyDivision, witnessing the future of warfare—from immersive drone labs to live demonstrations of cutting-edge surveillance and combat technologies.
Here, medicine meets mission readiness.
Here, care evolves with combat.
Because on tomorrow’s battlefield, every second saved means a life protected. 🇮🇳

🚨 युद्धभूमि में चिकित्सा का नया आयाम! ⚕️🛡️

आधुनिक युद्ध में फ्रंटलाइन पर तेज़, स्मार्ट और तकनीक आधारित चिकित्सा ही जीवन रेखा है।
Senior Medical Officers Command Course और Medical Officers Basic Course के 153 मेडिकल अधिकारियों ने #GoldenKeyDivision की सैदपुर ब्रिगेड का दौरा किया और देखा भविष्य के युद्धक्षेत्र की तैयारी—ड्रोन लैब का अनुभव और अत्याधुनिक ड्रोन व निगरानी प्रणालियों का लाइव प्रदर्शन।
यहाँ चिकित्सा और युद्ध तैयारी का संगम है।
क्योंकि युद्ध में हर बचा हुआ सेकंड एक जीवन बचाता है। 🇮🇳

#युद्धतत्परता #भविष्यकेलिएतैयार #संयुक्तशक्ति

⚔️ FRONTLINE FIRE IN THE KUMAON HILLS! 🏔️

Where oxygen is thin and resolve is iron, leadership walks the same icy ground as the warriors.
Lt Gen Harpal Singh, AVSM, VSM, DG BRO, pushed deep into the rugged Kumaon frontier to review critical border infrastructure and meet the indomitable Panchshul Warriors. 🛡️
Amid biting winds and unforgiving heights, he saluted their grit, courage and unwavering vigilance guarding the nation’s northern ramparts. 🇮🇳
When leaders lead from the front, the mountains echo with resolve.

🔥 कुमाऊँ की चोटियों पर लौह संकल्प! 🏔️
जहाँ सांसें भी चुनौती बन जाती हैं, वहाँ देश के वीर प्रहरी अडिग खड़े हैं।
Lt Gen Harpal Singh, AVSM, VSM, DG BRO ने दुर्गम कुमाऊँ सीमा क्षेत्र का दौरा कर सीमा सड़क विकास कार्यों की समीक्षा की और साहसी Panchshul Warriors से मुलाकात की। 🛡️
बर्फीली ऊँचाइयों पर डटे इन जवानों की अदम्य हिम्मत, उच्च मनोबल और राष्ट्र के प्रति समर्पण को उन्होंने सलाम किया। 🇮🇳
जब नेतृत्व मोर्चे तक पहुँचता है, तो हर शिखर राष्ट्रभक्ति से गूंज उठता है।

text:
🚨 WHEN FLAMES RAGED, WARRIORS CHARGED IN! 🔥🇮🇳

Chaos erupted as a massive fire tore through the iconic #HeritageMarket of #Kasauli. Gas cylinders exploded, timber and shop stock fed the inferno, and 8 shops were engulfed in seconds. The danger of a catastrophic spread loomed large.
But when crisis strikes, India’s protectors step forward. 💪
Troops of VC Brigade, #GoldenKeyDivision, alongside #AirForce Station and #KasauliCantonment, launched a swift, coordinated response—battling flames, evacuating civilians, and containing the blaze before disaster multiplied.
This is the spirit of service:
“परोपकारार्थं इदं शरीरम्” — the body exists to serve others.
Duty above danger. Nation above self. 🇮🇳🔥

🚨 जब आग भड़की… तो सैनिक दीवार बनकर खड़े हो गए! 🔥🇮🇳

#Kasauli के ऐतिहासिक #HeritageMarket में भीषण आग ने अफरा-तफरी मचा दी। गैस सिलेंडरों के धमाके, लकड़ी और दुकानों के सामान ने आग को और भड़का दिया—देखते ही देखते 8 दुकानें चपेट में आ गईं, और पूरा बाज़ार खतरे में था।
लेकिन संकट की घड़ी में भारत के रक्षक पीछे नहीं हटते। 💪
VC Brigade, #GoldenKeyDivision, #AirForce Station और #KasauliCantonment की संयुक्त कार्रवाई ने तुरंत मोर्चा संभाला—आग से जंग लड़ी, हालात काबू में किए और एक बड़े हादसे को टाल दिया।
यही है सेवा का सच्चा मंत्र—
