World Autism Day : Ladakh *Creating inclusive learning spaces* Fire and Fury Corps, in collaboration with the Education Department, UT of Ladakh organised a special session on *World Autism Awareness Day* at Army Goodwill School Dras. Army doctors conducted an insightful lecture for teachers on early identification of Autism Spectrum Disorder and effective classroom strategies to support autistic students. #WorldAutismAwarenessDay #InclusiveEducation @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @ANI

GOC and all ranks of Fire and Fury Corps convey heartfelt greetings to all ranks, veterans and families of the Mechanised Infantry Regiment on the occasion of their 47th Raising Day. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodef_leh https://t.co/iZokwikCTe

First Aid and Emergency Response: Ladakh Preparedness saves lives. Indian Army conducted emergency medical training for veterans and civilians of Drass in a collaborative effort with the civil administration to enhance disaster response capabilities of the region. A total of 31 community members were trained on first aid and emergency response on 28-29 Mar 2026. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI

Skill Development: Ladakh Fire and Fury corps conducted a Motor Skills Camp at Nimu Village with the aim of enhancing technical awareness, practical aptitude and employability skills among local youth & women. Participants were actively engaged in structured sessions covering basic motor skills development, vehicle awareness, safety practices and hands on familiarisation, enabling them to gain practical exposure. The camp also included interactive guidance sessions on career pathways in technical trades to pursue skill based professions and broaden their aspirations. The programme witnessed enthusiastic participation from the youth and women. #OpSadbhavana #YouthEmpowerment #SkillDevelopment @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI

Medical Camp: Ladakh A door to door medical outreach program was conducted in Batalik, delivering essential healthcare services to residents in the remote border areas. The initiative addressed critical medical needs in the remote high altitude region and strengthened the enduring bond of trust between the Army and community members. #Healthcare #DoorToDoorMedicalCamp @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @lg_ladakh

Block Printing Workshop under Fire & Fury Corps On 26 & 27 March 2026, a vibrant Block Printing Workshop was conducted at Shachukul Vocational Training Centre in Ladakh. Through hands on training, live demonstrations and focussed interactions, participants enhanced their skills in design, colour application and finishing paving the way for entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods in the region. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI

Enhancing interoperability & Combat preparedness, troops of Shaurya Commando Platoon #ITBP underwent intensive training with #FireAndFuryCorps in New Generation Weapons, Mountaineering skills, Drone Operations & Unarmed Combat. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @ANI @ITBP_official

The initiative aims to reduce dependence on conventional energy sources, ensure reliable power supply in remote areas and promote eco-friendly practices. It stands as a testament to the Army’s dedication towards innovation, operational efficiency, and environmental stewardship. #SolarPower #HybridEnergy #SustainableFuture @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI

Youth Empowerment: Ladakh An educational outreach Program - #ProjUdan was conducted from 11 to 25 Mar 2026 at Secondary School, Yourgo Village. Students were engaged in a series of interactive learning activities including orientation sessions, team building exercises, public speaking, debate competitions, digital literacy classes, quiz and sports activities aimed at enhancing their confidence and overall personality. The programme witnessed enthusiastic participation from students, who benefitted from career counselling sessions to explore diverse career opportunities and develop a positive outlook towards their future. The closing ceremony featured a vibrant cultural programme by the students. The initiative received an overwhelming response from the community, further strengthening the bond between #IndianArmy and the youth of Ladakh. #Education #YouthEmpowerment #Ladakh @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @lg_ladakh @MSDESkillIndia @ANI

Humanitarian Assistance: Chang La Pass – 24 Mar 26 On night 24 Mar 26, heavy snowfall caused a road block leaving 46 vehicles with 128 civilians stranded near Chang La Top. Amidst rapidly deteriorating weather conditions, Indian Army personnel deployed at Chang La Pass cleared the road over six relentless hours. Stranded passengers thanked Indian Army’s enduring ethos of Service Before Self, where courage, commitment and compassion prevail even in the harshest of environments. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI

World TB Day On the eve of World Tuberculosis Day, Fire and Fury Corps medical teams reached remote border villages to provide screening and awareness on Tuberculosis. Medical Camps were organised at Chushul, Nimu and other remote villages. The camp emphasised the importance of early detection and complete treatment of Tuberculosis. #TBMuktBharat @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI @DIPR_Leh

Shaheed Diwas In tribute to the brave hearts of India’s freedom struggle #ShaheedDiwas was commemorated with students and community members of Govt School, Ang, Khaltse (Leh). Poster making competition and lectures were conducted honouring our martyrs and inspiring youth towards nation building. #IndianArmy #NationFirst @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @ANI

Shaheed Diwas Fire and Fury Corps observed Shaheed Diwas with the community members of Punguk Village in #ChangthangRegion, paying homage to the brave martyrs who sacrificed their lives for the nation. The event witnessed enthusiastic participation by community members as well as troops and strengthened the spirit of patriotism and unity. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @ANI @prodefleh @ULadakh

International Water Day: Pangong Tso An Environmental Initiative was successfully executed at Maan Village with enthusiastic participation of community members. The event featured screening of a documentary on water conservation, cleanliness drive along the shores of Pangong Tso and an engaging quiz to raise environmental awareness. Such initiatives underscore the unwavering dedication of Fire and Fury Corps towards empowering border communities while protecting Ladakh’s fragile ecosystem. #InternationalWaterDay @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @ANI @ULadakh

International Water Day: Ladakh On 22 Mar 26, International Water Day was observed across remote border areas of Ladakh, including Padum, Thasgam, Sankoo, Batalik & Drass. Extensive awareness drives on water conservation, sanitation and sustainable usage were conducted, benefiting local communities. The initiative aimed to educate residents, promote efficient water management practices and reinforce the importance of preserving scarce water resources in these harsh, high altitude regions. #WorldWaterDay @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh

Skill Development: Ladakh Fire and Fury Corps organised a Skill Development Programme from 09 to 21 March 2026 at Shachukul Village, Tangtse in collaboration with Jan Shiksha Sansthan, Leh under Skill India Initiative of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE). 30 Women participants were trained with certified skills of Soft Toy Making and Mushroom Growing by Instructors of MSDE with support from Trishul Division. The initiative aims to increase the self employment opportunities for women of Shachukul Village. The programme witnessed enthusiastic participation from the beneficiaries. #SkillDevelopment #WomenEmpowerment #SelfEmployment #ShachukulVillage #Ladakh @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @lg_ladakh @MSDESkillIndia @ANI

Awareness Lecture on Army Recruitment: Durbuk On 20 Mar 2026, Indian Army conducted a recruitment awareness lecture at Durbuk, guiding youth on diverse entry schemes as Officers and Agniveers. The session provided clarity on career pathways and avenues to serve the nation with pride and dedication. The event was well received by participants. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodef_leh @ULadakh @ANI

Promoting Entrepreneurship An industrial fruit juicer machine was installed at the Community Hall in Saspol Village, Ladakh, under Operation Sadbhavana. The initiative aims to promote sustainable livelihoods while encouraging entrepreneurship and self employment among the population. The beneficiaries have expressed appreciation for Fire and Fury Corps’ steadfast commitment to empowering border communities and fostering inclusive nation building. #Ladakh #OpSadbhavana @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @ANI @adgpi

Medical Camp at Tharuk Village Reinforcing the steadfast commitment to the well being of border area population, a comprehensive medical camp was organised at Govt Middle School, Tharuk, Tangtse, extending vital healthcare services. A dedicated team of Army Medical Staff rendered compassionate care through detailed consultations, basic diagnostics and distribution of essential medicines to more than 100 community members and school students, addressing a diverse spectrum of health concerns with utmost professionalism and empathy. The initiative evoked heartfelt appreciation from the local populace, who lauded the Indian Army not only for vigilantly safeguarding the nation’s frontiers but also for its unwavering commitment to humanitarian service and community upliftment. #ServiceBeforeSelf #WinningHeartsAndMinds #OpSadbhavana @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @lg_ladakh @ANI

CAREER COUNSELLING SEMINAR : KHALTSI A Career Counselling Seminar was organised at Khaltsi in coordination with the Education Society. The interactive session offered a comprehensive roadmap for higher education, highlighting opportunities in Army Educational Institutions as well as career avenues in the Armed Forces and the corporate sector. Despite inclement weather and sub zero temperatures, the event witnessed enthusiastic participation from approximately 135 students, over 50 parents and faculty members from various educational institutions. Veterans including Honorary Captain (Subedar Major)Chhering Stobdan (Retired), a Vir Chakra awardee and military & government officials attended the event and interacted with the youth. Participants appreciated the initiative, noting that its consistent conduct over the past two years has made it highly beneficial. @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prodefleh @adgpi

Climate Resilient Villages: Ladakh To effectively address climate challenges, communities must adapt to hazards such as floods, droughts and heatwaves. Adopting climate smart agriculture, water conservation measures, solar energy and efficient waste management is essential to safeguard livelihoods while reducing emissions. Fire and Fury Corps conducted awareness sessions in Chushul, Tsaga and Hanle villages of the Changthang Region, highlighting pathways to build climate resilient communities. The interactions focused on sustainable water management, climate resilient farming, renewable energy adoption and disaster preparedness. Strengthening community resilience in the fragile Himalayan ecosystem will enhance collective capability and long term sustainability. #ClimateResilience #SustainableFuture @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @lg_ladakh @prasarbharti @ANI @ddnewsladakh

GOC Fire and Fury Corps and all ranks congratulate Subedar Iqbal Singh for clinching Gold Medal in the 5th Masters’ National Weightlifting Championship 2025-26 held in Loharu, Haryana from 14 to 15 March 2026. Subedar Iqbal Singh participated in +110kg category, lifting 95kg in snatch and 125kg in clean & jerk. @adgpi @NorthernComd_IA @prodefleh @ANI

text:
📰 $1,776 'Warrior Dividend' tax-free, IRS confirms

The Internal Revenue Service confirmed that the $1,776 "Warrior Dividend" more than 1.5 million service members received last year, at the direction of President Donald J. Trump, would be tax-free.

In a press release posted Jan. 16, the IRS confirmed the tax-free status of the dividend.

"The Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service today confirmed that supplemental basic allowance for housing payments made to members of the uniformed services in December 2025 are not to be included in income by those who received the payments; they are not taxable," the statement reads.

According to the IRS, U.S. tax law excludes from gross income a "qualified military benefit." The Warrior Dividend is just such a benefit and is therefore not taxable. Service members will keep all of the dividend to use as they see fit.

"The tax-free Warrior Dividend places $1,776 directly in the hands of our warfighters and their families," said Pentagon Press Secretary Kingsley Wilson. "The department is proud to recognize their sacrifice."

On Dec. 17, 2025, the president announced that nearly 1.5 million service members would receive a $1,776 bonus to both thank them for their military service and to commemorate the 250 years the U.S. military has been defending the nation.

"Nobody deserves it more than our military," he said. "I say, 'congratulations' to everybody."

In a related statement, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said the dividend illustrates the nation's commitment to military service members.

"This Warrior Dividend serves as yet another example of how the War Department is working to improve the quality of life for our military personnel and their families," Hegseth said. "All elements of what we're doing are to rebuild our military."

Veteran Achievers Award: Recognising Contributions, Rewarding Excellence.

#GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, felicitated five distinguished #veterans during his visit to #Pune for their exceptional contributions to #NationBuilding, social welfare and community empowerment.

Lieutenant Colonel Vinod Marwaha (Retd), has made notable contributions in veteran resettlement, education, renewable energy and environmental conservation. His initiatives have provided vocational training, employment and welfare support to hundreds of ex-servicemen.

Major Sanjay Shinde (Retd), has transformed his post-retirement journey into a mission of social entrepreneurship, empowering rural women, specially-abled persons and local families through Sun24 FMCG Pvt Ltd.

Subedar Ajit Kallapa Patil (Retd), has dedicated himself to the welfare of ex-servicemen, widows and Veer Naris. Having assisted over 1,500 beneficiaries in pension-related matters and founded Sainik #NariShakti Samstha.

Sergeant Suresh Shivram Dumbre (Retd), has rendered commendable service in mental health awareness, de-addiction support and community outreach through Parivartan Trust, Pune. His efforts have helped reduce stigma, encourage early treatment and promote social inclusion.

Naik Sampat Shamrao Jadhav (Retd), has consistently supported ex-servicemen, widows and the local community through pension guidance, ECHS assistance, tree plantation, blood donation camps, cleanliness drives and women’s self-help groups.

“Service is a lifelong journey - building a stronger, united India.”

#RespectAndRecognition

Exercise #PRAGATI Lieutenant General Dhiraj Seth, #VCOAS, along with Vice Chiefs and senior military leaders from participating nations, witnessed the Final Validation Exercise and Closing Ceremony of the maiden edition of Multilateral Military Exercise #PRAGATI 2026 at Umroi, Meghalaya. The event marked the successful culmination of a landmark multinational engagement. Bringing together over 400 troops from 12 Friendly Foreign Countries, the exercise fostered camaraderie and enhanced operational synergy. On the occasion, Dag Hammarskjöld Medals were awarded posthumously to Lance Havildar Harbhajan Singh and Naib Subedar Sujit Kumar Pradhan in honour of their exemplary courage, dedication and sacrifice in the line of duty. Marking the occasion, the #IndianArmy also hosted a dialogue on “Future of UN Global Peacekeeping” at Manekshaw Centre, attended by Mr Stefan Priesner, Amb Ruchira Kamboj, Lieutenant General Satish Nambiar (Retd) and other senior military dignitaries, reaffirming India’s steadfast commitment towards global peace and security. @UN @UNPeacekeeping @CUNPKIndia

Indian Army and M/s Air India Ltd signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) in the presence of #GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, towards further strengthening welfare initiatives for the Army fraternity. Built on the three pillars of Employment, Empowerment and Environment, the partnership aims to create lifelong employment avenues for Veer Naris and their wards, support vocational training infrastructure in ASHA Schools and promote environment-friendly mobility solutions at Army Hospitals. Under the initiative, 20 vacancies for Veer Naris and 40 vacancies for their wards will be provided across seven airports. In addition, vocational laboratories will be established in 25 ASHA Schools and battery-operated carts inducted at Army Hospitals to enhance patient mobility and care. @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD

The #COAS then paid heartfelt tributes to the families of Organ Donors, whose selfless decision in moments of personal grief gave the priceless gift of life to patients. On the occasion, Dr Subhash Gupta, a renowned Hepato-biliary and Liver Transplant surgeon was awarded with COAS Commendation Card for his contribution to the success of the organ transplant program in the Armed Forces. Emphasising the spirit of ‘Seva Parmo Dharma’, the #COAS encouraged Armed Forces personnel, veterans and civilians to pledge for organ donation. He appreciated the efforts of Armed Forces Organ Retrieval & Transplant Authority (AORTA) in promoting organ donation. @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD @dgafms_mod @DIAV20

Veteran Achievers Award: Recognising Contributions, Rewarding Excellence

#GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, felicitated four distinguished Veterans with the ‘Veteran Achievers Award’ for their exceptional post-retirement contributions to Nation Building, social welfare and youth empowerment during the Retiring Officers Seminar at New Delhi.

Colonel DP Dimri (Retd) has dedicated himself to youth empowerment, education and rural development in Uttarakhand. He established a library for underprivileged students and founded an institute in Rudraprayag post Kedarnath floods, providing free/subsidised coaching. 

Captain Reeta Rajkishor Biyani (Retd), a cancer survivor and Limca Record holder, has led a nationwide cancer awareness movement through Highways Infinite. She has travelled extensively, conducting thousands of workshops and impacting lakhs of individuals through awareness, screenings and support initiatives. 

Subedar (Honorary Captain) Tsewang Norbo (Retd) has driven socio-economic upliftment in remote regions through environmental, educational and community initiatives. He led plantation drives, supported schools and assisted veterans in accessing benefits. His mentorship has also enabled several local youth to join the Armed Forces.

Subedar Bhaskar Parida (Retd) has been a pillar of support for the veteran community in Odisha, assisting in pension, healthcare and welfare issues. He leads environmental and marine conservation efforts, including large-scale plantation and beach cleaning drives. He also ensures dignified last rites and promotes awareness on respect for national values.

‘Service is a Lifelong Journey; Building a Stronger, United #India.’

#GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS felicitated four distinguished veterans during his visit to Bengaluru for their exceptional contribution to nation-building, social welfare and community empowerment.

Havildar SC Thimmaiah (Retd) has significantly transformed rural livelihoods in Kodagu through innovative integrated agro-farming practices. By promoting labour-saving techniques and multi-cropping systems, he has driven widespread adoption across regions. His impactful work has earned him numerous honours, including recognition from ICAR and the Karnataka Rajyotsava Award for excellence in agriculture.

Colonel SS Rajan (Retd) has devoted himself to the welfare and resettlement of veterans. He has actively addressed a wide range of issues affecting ex-servicemen and represented their concerns with state authorities. He has also ensured the dignified conduct of Commemoration Ceremonies such as Kargil Diwas and Vijay Diwas at the National Military Memorial, Bengaluru, while continuing to mentor youth and veterans towards meaningful national service.

Colonel Nitteguthu Sharath Bhandaray (Retd) has rendered exemplary service in public administration and veteran welfare. As Chairman of the Lok Adalat under the Karnataka High Court, he has effectively resolved numerous grievances of veterans. He has also spearheaded several social initiatives, supporting economically weaker sections, guiding youth towards career in the Armed Forces, and leading welfare activities through charitable organisations.

Commander Veeraghava Kuppuswamy Santhanam (Retd) has harnessed digital platforms to support the veteran community by spreading awareness on ECHS policies and procedures. With over 128 informative videos and hands-on volunteer assistance in hospitals, he has enabled countless veterans to access healthcare benefits and navigate reimbursement processes with ease.

“Service is a lifelong journey - building a stronger, united India.”

Veteran Achievers Award: Recognising Contributions, Rewarding Excellence

#GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, felicitated five distinguished Veterans with the ‘Veteran Achievers Award’ for their exceptional post-retirement contributions to Nation Building, social welfare and youth empowerment during his visit to Secunderabad.

Commodore Pravin Rajpal (Retd) has served as Secretary of the Navy Foundation Hyderabad Charter since 2021, working tirelessly for Veterans and Veer Naris. He has helped resolve ECHS, pension and documentation issues, assisted widows during medical emergencies and ensured benefits such as OROP arrears.

Colonel Arunkumar Krishna Moghe (Retd) has devoted his life to humanitarian service, caring for persons affected by leprosy, spastic children, orphans and persons with disabilities. In recognition of his selfless work in rehabilitation and social welfare, he has been honoured with the Sasakawa Memorial Award by the World Health Organisation.

Lieutenant Colonel Gurram Ram Reddy (Retd) has contributed significantly to youth empowerment in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. As a founding member of the Malla Reddy Group of Institutions, he has helped provide quality technical education and employment opportunities to over 35,000 youth.

Honorary Captain Narayan Panigrahi (Retd) has been instrumental in resolving pension and grievance-related issues of Veterans and their next of kin through the Veterans Cell, Telangana and Andhra Sub Area. He is also actively associated with Veteran Seva Kendra Plus, helping resolve numerous long-pending cases.

Aircraftsman Chalasani Bala Ram Prasad (Retd), a two-time National Weightlifting Champion, is a successful poultry farmer and philanthropist. Demonstrating exceptional generosity, he has pledged nearly 97 percent of his lifetime earnings, including land assets in Hyderabad and Vijayawada, for charitable causes and social welfare.

‘Service is a Lifelong Journey; Building a Stronger, United #India.’

Veteran Achievers Award: Recognising Contributions, Rewarding Excellence

#GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, honoured five distinguished #Veterans, with the ‘Veteran Achievers Award’ during his visit to Wellington. The recognised veterans exemplify selfless service beyond the uniform, making meaningful contributions across diverse fields and furthering the cause of Nation Building.

Major K. N. Selvan (Retd) established the Nilgiris ESM Welfare Association in 2002. Since then, he has been actively assisting Veterans of the district in resolving their issues. He regularly liaises with Record Offices and the Civil Administration to facilitate timely resolution of Veterans’ grievances.

Subedar Major (Honorary Captain) Sannayallappa Talwar (Retd) has been working for the welfare of Veterans in the Belagavi district. In 2025, he played a key role in organising a Veterans Outreach Programme, which resulted in the resolution of more than 900 grievances.

Subedar (Honorary Subedar Major) B Ravi (Retd) has been working for the welfare of veterans in Tirunelveli district. Acting as a link between veterans, Record Offices and Civil Administration, he has helped resolve over 350 grievances and facilitated correction of more than 170 Part II Orders. During the 2023 floods, he also assisted more than 140 veterans facing difficulties.

Sergeant Ravi R (Retd), along with Major K. N. Selvan (Retd), established the Nilgiris ESM Welfare Association in 2002. He continues to assist veterans in resolving their issues and actively motivates youth of the Nilgiris district to join the Armed Forces.

Petty Officer E. Jagadeesan (Retd) has been motivating youth to join the Armed Forces and guiding them in preparation for entrance examinations and physical tests. His efforts have helped 78 candidates join the Forces. He also assists veterans and Veer Naris in resolving their problems.

‘Service is a Lifelong Journey; Building a Stronger, United #India.’

#GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, was presented the book “The Digital Decades: Thirty Years of the Internet in India,” authored by Subimal Bhattacharjee, a noted policy adviser on cyber, AI and defence technologies as well as Editorial Board Member of the Cyber Journal at Chatham House.

The book traces the remarkable journey of the world’s largest democracy as it harnessed internet technology to transform governance, empower citizens and drive national development. Across 19 chapters, it captures the technological, political and social forces that shaped India’s digital evolution.

From the first internet connections in 1995 through liberalisation, the mobile revolution and successive digital governance initiatives, the narrative culminates in the vision of Digital India, blending sharp analysis with engaging human stories behind the transformation.

Developed jointly by Indian Army & BISAG-N, DIME now operationalises standardised digital workflows across all depots and units, while equipping commanders with integrated dashboards, exception alerts and predictive stock analytics for proactive logistics.

Constable Vikash Singh Rawat
Constable Anwar Hussain
Constable Mahaveer Prasad
Constable Mohan Singh

A tribute to the nation, a salute to the Tricolour, and another golden chapter in the legacy of the BSF.

21st May 2026

Scaling the world’s highest peak with unmatched courage and determination, BSF’s first ever All Women Mt. Everest Expedition Team has scripted history under #MissionVandeMataram by successfully summiting Mt. Everest.

The BSF’s First all women mountaineering team comprising of Constable Kouser Fatima
from Ladakh, Constable Munmun Ghosh from West Bengal, Constable Rabeka Singh from Uttarakhand and Constable Tsering Chorol from Kargil, successfully summited the Mt Everest (8848.86 M) at 8 AM (IST) today.

At an altitude where most people require oxygen support and even standing upright is a challenge, they sang Vande Mataram in one unwavering voice - creating a historic milestone that reflects the strength, resilience and indomitable spirit of Nari Shakti.

This extraordinary achievement stands as a proud symbol of women empowerment, national pride and the BSF’s steadfast commitment to excellence.

On the occasion of #WorldNoTobaccoDay, #BlazingSwordDivision & #RedHornsDivision, under the aegis of #GajrajCorps, organised a series of Military-Civil Fusion initiatives across Arunachal Pradesh, reaffirming their commitment to a healthier, tobacco-free society.

#SelaWarriors conducted a Medical Camp at Thingbu Village, providing healthcare services, medical consultations &  health awareness to over 200 local residents.

In addition, a badminton tournament was organised for the youth & students of Senge, while a Motorcycle Rally from #Paneri to Shergaon promoted fitness, healthy lifestyles & awareness of the harmful effects of tobacco.

#WorldNoTobaccoDay के अवसर पर #BlazingSwordDivision और #RedHornsDivision ने #GajrajCorps के तत्वावधान में अरुणाचल प्रदेश में कई Military-Civil Fusion गतिविधियों का आयोजन किया। इन पहलों के माध्यम से स्वस्थ और तंबाकू-मुक्त समाज के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता को दोहराया गया।

#SelaWarriors ने Thingbu Village में एक Medical Camp आयोजित किया, जिसमें 200 से अधिक स्थानीय लोगों को स्वास्थ्य सेवाएँ, चिकित्सा परामर्श और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी जागरूकता प्रदान की गई।

इसके साथ ही, Senge के युवाओं और विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक Badminton Tournament आयोजित किया गया। वहीं, #Paneri से Shergaon तक एक Motorcycle Rally निकाली गई, जिसका उद्देश्य फिटनेस, स्वस्थ जीवनशैली और तंबाकू के हानिकारक प्रभावों के प्रति जागरूकता फैलाना था।

#WorldNoTobaccoDay #MilitaryCivilFusion #HealthyNation #RideForFitness

#GajrajCorps paid tribute to the enduring legacy of Late Capt Gautam Sarma, 8 JAK LI, by supporting the unveiling of his statue at Biswanath, Assam. The ceremony was graced by Lt Gen RP Kalita, PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, SM, VSM (Retd) & attended by veterans, members of the civil administration, ex-servicemen & local citizens.

A proud son of Assam, Late Capt Gautam Sarma made the supreme sacrifice while leading an operational patrol in Jammu & Kashmir in 2007. His courage, selfless service and unwavering devotion to duty continue to inspire generations & serve as a shining example of patriotism & valour.

#GajrajCorps ने बिस्वनाथ, असम में Late Capt Gautam Sarma, 8 JAK LI की प्रतिमा के अनावरण में सहयोग देकर उनकी अमर विरासत को श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित की। इस समारोह में Lt Gen RP Kalita, PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, SM, VSM (Retd) सहित पूर्व सैनिकों, नागरिक प्रशासन के अधिकारियों और स्थानीय नागरिकों ने भाग लिया।

असम के गौरव Late Capt Gautam Sarma ने वर्ष 2007 में जम्मू-कश्मीर में एक ऑपरेशनल पेट्रोल का नेतृत्व करते हुए सर्वोच्च बलिदान दिया। उनका साहस, निस्वार्थ सेवा और कर्तव्य के प्रति अटूट समर्पण आज भी पीढ़ियों को प्रेरित करता है तथा देशभक्ति और वीरता का उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण प्रस्तुत करता है।

#GajrajCorps conducted joint flood relief exercise #JalAapda at #Tawang, #ArunachalPradesh on 11–12 May 2026 in coordination with the District Administration, #NDRF, #SDRF, #NCC cadets, NGOs and CAPFs to enhance preparedness against rain-induced landslides & mudslides. Located along the Nyamjang Chu & Tawang Chu river systems, the region’s mountainous terrain remains highly vulnerable to sudden natural calamities. The exercise incorporated lessons from major landslides in similar terrain & their practical application during realistic debris-slide scenarios. Live demonstrations by Incident Response Teams showcased coordinated rescue, evacuation & relief operations. The exercise strengthened inter-agency synergy, enhanced rapid response mechanisms & reaffirmed #IndianArmy’s commitment to effective disaster management & safeguarding lives in high-altitude areas. #GajrajCorps ने 11–12 मई 2026 को #Tawang, #ArunachalPradesh में संयुक्त बाढ़ राहत अभ्यास #JalAapda आयोजित किया। यह अभ्यास District Administration, #NDRF, #SDRF, #NCC कैडेट्स, NGOs और CAPFs के साथ मिलकर किया गया, ताकि बारिश से होने वाले भूस्खलन और कीचड़ धंसने जैसी आपदाओं से निपटने की तैयारी बेहतर हो सके। Nyamjang Chu और Tawang Chu नदी क्षेत्र के पास स्थित यह पहाड़ी इलाका अचानक आने वाली प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के लिए बहुत संवेदनशील माना जाता है। इस अभ्यास में पहले हुए बड़े भूस्खलनों से मिली सीख को वास्तविक मलबा-धंसाव जैसी परिस्थितियों में लागू किया गया। Incident Response Teams ने बचाव, निकासी और राहत कार्यों का लाइव प्रदर्शन किया। इस अभ्यास से विभिन्न एजेंसियों के बीच तालमेल मजबूत हुआ, त्वरित प्रतिक्रिया प्रणाली बेहतर बनी और #IndianArmy ने उच्च पर्वतीय क्षेत्रों में प्रभावी आपदा प्रबंधन और लोगों की सुरक्षा के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई। #RescueOps #DisasterManagement @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIB_India @DefenceMinIndia @PemaKhanduBJP @NamgyalAngmo @HQ_DG_NCC @ITBP_official @SSB_INDIA @NDRFHQ @HQ_DG_NCC @nccner

Their prompt action averted a major tragedy & ensured protection of affected area. #GajrajCorps ने #Dahung #ArunachalPradesh में Shaitan Bridge के पास लगी भीषण आग पर तुरंत कार्रवाई की। आग तेजी से फैलते हुए Singchung Circle के Thiring Pum village की नागरिक बस्तियों की ओर बढ़ रही थी और बहुमूल्य जान-माल व स्थानीय पर्यावरण को खतरा पहुँचा रही थी। उनकी त्वरित कार्रवाई से एक बड़ी दुर्घटना टल गई और प्रभावित क्षेत्र की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित की गई। #IndianArmy #ServiceBeforeSelf #NationFirst @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIB_India @DefenceMinIndia

𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐮𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐄𝐱𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐞 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐀𝐥𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞 𝐓𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧 Troops of #GajrajCorps undertook specialised avalanche safety & rescue drills alongside expert trainers from the Tiranga Mountain Rescue Team (TMR), honing critical decision-making, extraction techniques & survival skills in rugged Eastern Himalayas. Conducted in frontier regions of Arunachal Pradesh at heights above 14,000 feet, the immersive training boosted operational readiness, crisis response efficiency & vital life-saving competence, reinforcing safe & sustained operations in formidable high-altitude terrain. #GajrajCorps के सैनिकों ने Kameng sector की अत्यधिक ठंड में Tiranga Mountain Rescue (TMR) Team के विशेषज्ञ प्रशिक्षकों के साथ विशेष avalanche safety और rescue अभ्यास किए। इस दौरान महत्वपूर्ण निर्णय लेने, extraction तकनीकों और survival skills को और बेहतर बनाया गया। Arunachal Pradesh के ऊपरी क्षेत्रों में लगभग 14,000 feet की ऊँचाई पर आयोजित इस गहन field training से operational readiness, संकट के समय त्वरित प्रतिक्रिया और जीवन-रक्षक क्षमताओं में उल्लेखनीय बढ़ोतरी हुई, जिससे कठिन high-altitude terrain में सुरक्षित और निरंतर संचालन को मजबूती मिली। #IndianArmy #AvalancheRescue #HighAltitudeTraining #OperationalPreparedness #Resilience @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @DefenceMinIndia @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India

𝑴𝒂𝒋 𝑹𝒂𝒍𝒆𝒏𝒈𝒏𝒂𝒐 𝑩𝒐𝒃 𝑲𝒉𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒏𝒈 : 𝑺𝒂𝒍𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒂 𝑯𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒄 𝑳𝒆𝒈𝒂𝒄𝒚 𝒂𝒕 𝑻𝒂𝒘𝒂𝒏𝒈 #GajrajCorps paid homage to legendary Maj Ralengnao Bob Khating in a solemn wreath-laying ceremony at #Tawang. Patriotic performances by schoolchildren filled the air with pride, reflecting strong Military–Civil synergy. The occasion reaffirmed spirit of courage, duty and sacrifice. #GajrajCorps ने Tawang में महान Maj Ralengnao Bob Khating को श्रद्धांजलि दी। वहाँ एक शांत और सम्मानपूर्ण पुष्पांजलि समारोह आयोजित किया गया। स्कूल के बच्चों ने देशभक्ति कार्यक्रम प्रस्तुत किए, जिससे माहौल गर्व और सम्मान से भर गया। यह कार्यक्रम सेना और आम लोगों के बीच मजबूत सहयोग को दर्शाता है। इस अवसर पर साहस, कर्तव्य और बलिदान की भावना को फिर से याद किया गया। #MajBobKhatingDay #NationFirst @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD @PIB_India @HQ_IDS_India @MyGovArunachal

𝑶𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒈𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒐𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒃𝒂𝒕𝒕𝒍𝒆𝒇𝒊𝒆𝒍𝒅 — 𝒇𝒐𝒄𝒖𝒔, 𝒈𝒓𝒊𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒉𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒅𝒆𝒇𝒊𝒏𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒂𝒓𝒓𝒊𝒐𝒓. #GajrajCorps, applauds Havildar Babu Singh for his exceptional performance at the Asian Championship – Rifle/Pistol held in New Delhi under the aegis of International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF), securing Bronze in 50m Rifle Prone (Men) Individual & Silver in Team Event. His achievement embodies the Indian Army’s ethos of discipline, precision and excellence in every mission. #GajrajCorps, Asian Championship – Rifle/Pistol, नई दिल्ली में Havildar Babu Singh के शानदार प्रदर्शन की सराहना करता है। उन्होंने 50m Rifle Prone (Men) Individual में 🥉 Bronze और Team Event में 🥈 Silver पदक जीतकर देश और सेना का गौरव बढ़ाया। उनकी यह उपलब्धि Indian Army की अनुशासन, सटीकता और हर मिशन में उत्कृष्टता की भावना को दर्शाती है। #ShootingChampionship #ISSF #DisciplineAndPrecision @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD @PIB_India @HQ_IDS_India @prodefgau

Forty IAS Probationary Officers visited forward areas of #GajrajCorps in West Kameng (Arunachal Pradesh) from 31 Jan to 05 Feb 2026. An extremely enriching visit provided the Probationers a first- hand exposure to soldiering & operational life in forward areas along the frontiers. Benefiting from close interaction with soldiers of Gajraj Corps, they gained valuable insights into operational realities & diverse terrain and weather related challenges. The experience besides enhancing their understanding of national security imperatives on the Northern Borders, fostered mutual respect & reinforced the spirit of Military - Civil Cooperation. चालीस IAS Probationary Officers ने 31 Jan से 05 Feb 2026 तक Arunachal Pradesh के West Kameng में #GajrajCorps के फॉरवर्ड एरिया का दौरा किया। यह दौरा बहुत ही उपयोगी और ज्ञानवर्धक रहा। इस दौरान Probationary Officers को पहली बार फॉरवर्ड एरिया में सैनिकों के जीवन और ऑपरेशनल कार्यों को करीब से देखने का अवसर मिला। Gajraj Corps के सैनिकों के साथ सीधे संवाद से उन्हें जमीनी हालात, अलग-अलग इलाकों और मौसम से जुड़ी चुनौतियों की अच्छी समझ मिली। इस अनुभव से Northern Borders पर राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा की जरूरतों को समझने में मदद मिली। साथ ही इससे Military - Civil Cooperation की भावना मजबूत हुई और आपसी सम्मान भी बढ़ा। #Jointness #IndianArmy #GajrajCorps #Tawang @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIB_India @DefenceMinIndia

𝐇𝐄𝐀𝐋𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐁𝐎𝐑𝐃𝐄𝐑𝐒, 𝐓𝐎𝐔𝐂𝐇𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐋𝐈𝐕𝐄𝐒 #KamengHealers of the #BallOfFireDivision under #GajrajCorps conducted medical camps at Singchung (West Kameng) & Holy Gorsam Chorten, Zemithang under #OpSADBHAVNA. Specialists from ENT, Ophthalmology & Dental disciplines examined & treated over 150 local residents, reaffirming the #IndianArmy’s commitment to healthcare outreach, community welfare & people-centric nation building in remote border areas. #GajrajCorps के अंतर्गत #BallOfFireDivision के #KamengHealers ने #OpSADBHAVNA के तहत सिंगचुंग (West Kameng) तथा Holy Gorsam Chorten, Zemithang में चिकित्सा शिविर आयोजित किए। ENT, Ophthalmology और Dental विशेषज्ञों ने 150 से अधिक स्थानीय नागरिकों की जांच एवं उपचार किया। यह पहल दूरदराज़ सीमा क्षेत्रों में स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं, सामुदायिक कल्याण और जन-केंद्रित राष्ट्र निर्माण के प्रति #IndianArmy की प्रतिबद्धता को दर्शाती है। #HealthcareOutreach #CommunityWelfare #CivilMilitarySynergy @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIBMoRTH @DefenceMinIndia

Jointness and Training towards Operational Excellence #IndianArmy, #ITBP & #SSB conducted joint training in the frontier areas of #ArunachalPradesh bolstering coordination & interoperability between the three forces. The training aimed at fostering seamless integration and interoperability wherein the personnel rehearsed synchronised operational drills, mastery of new generation weapons systems & latest equipment while also exchanging best practices. #IndianArmy, #ITBP और #SSB ने #ArunachalPradesh के सीमावर्ती इलाकों में मिलकर संयुक्त प्रशिक्षण किया। इस प्रशिक्षण से तीनों बलों के बीच तालमेल और आपसी काम करने की क्षमता मजबूत हुई। इस प्रशिक्षण का उद्देश्य बेहतर समन्वय और एक-दूसरे के साथ आसानी से काम करने की क्षमता बढ़ाना था। इसमें जवानों ने मिलकर एक साथ होने वाले अभियानों का अभ्यास किया, नई पीढ़ी के हथियारों और आधुनिक उपकरणों का प्रशिक्षण लिया, और अपने अनुभव व अच्छी कार्यप्रणालियों को साझा किया। #Jointness #NationalSecurity #Synergy @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIB_India @DefenceMinIndia @ITBP_official @SSB_INDIA @prodefgau

𝟏𝟓𝟎 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐕𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐦: 𝐄𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐚𝐭 𝐓𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐠 & 𝐍𝐲𝐮𝐤𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐮𝐧𝐠 𝐖𝐚𝐫 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐥𝐬 The #GajrajCorps celebrated 150 years of Vande Mataram at the iconic Tawang War Memorial & Nyukmadung War Memorial, Arunachal Pradesh Military bands & cultural performances, with vibrant participation from locals, tourists & nearby communities, witnessed the event with patriotic fervour, celebrating unity & spirit of military–civil synergy. #GajrajCorps ने अरुणाचल प्रदेश स्थित प्रतिष्ठित Tawang War Memorial और Nyukmadung War Memorial में वंदे मातरम् के 150 वर्ष पूरे होने का समारोह मनाया। इस अवसर पर सैन्य बैंड और सांस्कृतिक प्रस्तुतियाँ आयोजित की गईं, जिनमें स्थानीय लोगों, पर्यटकों और आसपास के क्षेत्रों के लोगों ने उत्साहपूर्वक भाग लिया। पूरे कार्यक्रम में देशभक्ति का जोश देखने को मिला और सैन्य–नागरिक एकता व समन्वय की भावना का सुंदर प्रदर्शन हुआ। #VandeMataram150 #GajrajCorps #IndianArmy @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD @PIB_India @HQ_IDS_India @MyGovArunachal

𝐂𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝟕𝟕𝐭𝐡 #𝐑𝐞𝐩𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐞! 🇮🇳 #GajrajCorps marked the occasion across #Assam & #ArunachalPradesh with a grand showcase of military-civil synergy. From weapon displays, car & cycle rallies to medical camps & cultural fests, the spirit of 'Nation First' shone bright. A heartfelt salute to the students, NCC cadets & local communities who joined us in celebrating our democratic heritage. #GajrajCorps ने #Assam एवं #ArunachalPradesh में इस अवसर को सैन्य–नागरिक समन्वय के भव्य प्रदर्शन के साथ मनाया। हथियार प्रदर्शनी, कार एवं साइकिल रैलियों से लेकर चिकित्सा शिविरों और सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों तक ‘Nation First’ की भावना स्पष्ट रूप से झलकी। हमारे लोकतांत्रिक विरासत के उत्सव में सहभागी बने छात्रों, NCC cadets तथा स्थानीय समुदायों को हार्दिक नमन। #IndianArmy #RepublicDay2026 #JaiHind @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @MyGovArunachal @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIB_India @DefenceMinIndia @prodefgau @CMOfficeAssam @mygovassam @PemaKhanduBJP

Strengthening Borders with Smart, Sustainable Infrastructure 🇮🇳 The #GajrajCorps Works & Land Conclave 4.0 was held at Tezpur, it brought together #Users #MES & #DEO reps in a shared mission to accelerate clean, green & future-ready defence infrastructure. Issues discussed included land regularisation in border states for stronger logistics, better troop accommodation & Smart Military Stations. Conclave was aimed at building readiness that aligns with the National priorities & secured tomorrow. #GajrajCorps Works & Land Conclave 4.0 का आयोज Tezpur में हुआ। इसमें #Users, #MES और #DEO के प्रतिनिधि शामिल हुए। सभी का उद्देश्य स्वच्छ, हरित और भविष्य के लिए तैयार रक्षा ढांचे को तेज़ी से आगे बढ़ाना था। बैठक में सीमा राज्यों में भूमि नियमितीकरण, मज़बूत लॉजिस्टिक्स, बेहतर सैनिक आवास और Smart Military Stations जैसे मुद्दों पर चर्चा हुई। Conclave का लक्ष्य राष्ट्रीय प्राथमिकताओं के अनुरूप तैयारी बढ़ाना और आने वाले समय को सुरक्षित बनाना था। #BorderSecurity #GreenInitiative @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @mygovassam @SpokespersonMoD @HQ_IDS_India @PIB_India @DefenceMinIndia

𝐒𝐞𝐥𝐟-𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐃𝐞𝐟𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 GOC #GajrajCorps interacted with Shri PB Rangarao, CEO Helicopter Complex–HAL, to enhance Army helicopter serviceability and MRO support for greater operational readiness in the Eastern Theatre. Later, GOC #BlazingSwordDivision & Shri Rangarao unveiled the foundation stone of HAL’s MRO Hub at Missamari, Assam—boosting faster repairs, logistics support for Army Aviation & IAF, and strengthening indigenous capability under #AtmanirbharBharat 🇮🇳🚁 GOC #GajrajCorps ने Shri PB Rangarao, CEO Helicopter Complex–HAL के साथ बातचीत की, जिसका उद्देश्य Eastern Theatre में बेहतर ऑपरेशनल तैयारी के लिए Army हेलिकॉप्टरों की सर्विसेबिलिटी और MRO सपोर्ट को मजबूत करना था। इसके बाद GOC #BlazingSwordDivision और Shri PB Rangarao ने Missamari, Assam में HAL के MRO Hub के शिलान्यास का अनावरण किया। यह hub Army Aviation और IAF इकाइयों के लिए तेज़ मरम्मत और बेहतर लॉजिस्टिक्स सपोर्ट सुनिश्चित करेगा तथा #AtmanirbharBharat के तहत स्वदेशी क्षमता को और सशक्त बनाएगा 🇮🇳🚁 #SelfReliantDefence #PoweringDefence #IndianArmy @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD @PIB_India @HQ_IDS_India @HALHQBLR @prodefgau

𝙃𝙀𝘼𝙇𝙏𝙃𝙔 𝘾𝙃𝙄𝙇𝘿𝙍𝙀𝙉, 𝙎𝙏𝙍𝙊𝙉𝙂 𝙉𝘼𝙏𝙄𝙊𝙉 Guided by the ethos of Sarve Santu Niramaya, medical teams from 321 Fd Hospital, Red Horns Division under #GajrajCorps conducted a comprehensive School Health Screening Programme at Fatima School, Rangia. Focused on preventive healthcare and basic medical & dental care for students and teachers, the initiative reinforces the Indian Army’s commitment to Nation Building through meaningful Military–Civil collaboration and sustained community outreach. “Sarve Santu Niramaya” की भावना से प्रेरित होकर, #GajrajCorps के अंतर्गत Red Horns Division के 321 Fd Hospital की मेडिकल टीमों ने Fatima School, Rangia में एक व्यापक School Health Screening Programme आयोजित किया। इस कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य बच्चों और शिक्षकों के लिए निवारक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल तथा बुनियादी चिकित्सा एवं Dental देखभाल सुनिश्चित करना था। यह पहल Indian Army की Nation Building के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता को दर्शाती है, जो सार्थक Military–Civil सहयोग और निरंतर सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के माध्यम से साकार हो रही है। #HealingHearts #StrengtheningBonds @adgpi @easterncomd @GajrajCorps_IA @DefenceMinIndia @SpokespersonMoD @PIB_India @HQ_IDS_India @prodefgau

Determination in Motion - An Aspirational Journey to OTA : Battalion Under Officer Aswin Kirupai

Battalion Under Officer Aswin Kirupai’s journey reflects resilience, self-belief, and unwavering commitment to her goal. Hailing from a remote village in Kanyakumari district, she displayed determination from an early age, excelling both in academics and sports. As a child, she represented her state at the sub-junior national level in long jump, winning a Bronze Medal at the age of eight. 

Life tested her resolve early with loss of his father at the age of 14, compelling her to shoulder responsibilities while remaining focused on her aspirations. Undeterred by any challenges encountered, Aswin continued to push her limits - academically, physically and mentally. She pursued an MSc in Computer Science and opted to be a NCC Cadet with a clear aim of becoming an officer in the #IndianArmy.

Her dedication translated into excellence at the national level, earning her the Gold Medal for being Best Cadet at All-India Thal Sainik Camp 2019, nomination for the Youth Exchange Programme and the Prime Minister’s Award 2020 for first place in the digital forum. With strong determination, perseverance and fortitude at SSB, she earned dividend in form of being recommended. Joining OTA Gaya under SSC (Tech) Women Course and having completed transformational military training, her journey is a powerful testament that persistence and purpose turn aspirations into achievement, including now *the Gold Medal* for standing First in the Order of Merit of Courses.

From Agniveer To An Officer, A Journey of Resolve : Battalion Cadet Adjutant Charan GV

FOC(W) SRIJANA GHALLEY : BEYOND THE COMFORT ZONE

Born in Samtse, Bhutan into a humble family of eight, Foreign Officer Cadet (Women) Srijana Ghalley discovered her calling to the military at an early age. She grew up far removed from the world of uniforms and military glory. However, a single fleeting encounter proved transformative, the sight of an officer in immaculate uniform passing through her village ignited an enduring aspiration, from that moment onward, her path was irrevocably set.

Upon completing her schooling, she earned a Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation and Control Engineering and commenced her professional career as a software engineer at Selise, Bhutan. Yet the call to serve the Nation proved stronger than the allure of corporate success. Choosing the glorious yet demanding path of military life over personal comfort, she stepped away from an established trajectory to pursue a higher calling - service before self.

She entered the hallowed portals of OTA, Chennai as a determined young woman with resolve in her heart. What followed was a demanding journey of rigorous training and deep resilience, moulding her into a character with steely resolve, ready to don the uniform of the Royal Bhutan Army. She learned that resilience is forged not in comfort, but in hardship, breathing in the trust of the nation alongwith her peers of various countries, who stood shoulder to shoulder with her in all these nine months of training.

Today, she stands transformed to become a commissioned member of the Royal Bhutan Army, a steadfast shield and an unwavering sword, prepared to serve with honour, loyalty and devotion to His Majesty, The King and the Kingdom of Bhutan.

text:
Two Brothers Don Stars From Two Academies: Celebration Beyond Words : Officer Cadet Deepak Kumar Mishra

Officer Cadet Deepak Kumar Mishra's transformation from IT professional to Army Officer embodies dedication, resilience and unwavering determination. Equipped with a Bachelor's degree and a Masters in Computer Science, Deepak spent three and a half years as a Network Operating Centre Engineer before pursuing his true calling.

His journey to Officers Training Academy, Gaya, was marked by steadfast commitment and continuous self-improvement. Despite arriving overweight and lacking physical stamina, Deepak embraced the challenge with remarkable determination. Through consistent practice and disciplined training, he transformed himself physically and mentally, successfully passing all his first and second Term examinations on first attempt.

Deepak's achievement carries profound family significance – he becomes the 1st Generation officer and 3rd Generation soldier in his family. His grandfather and father both served honourably for 30 years as Honorary Subedar Major in the Corps of EME, establishing a proud military heritage. On 7th March 2026, his family celebrates an extraordinary milestone – both Deepak and his younger brother SUO Krishna Kumar Mishra will be commissioned as officers on the same day from OTA, Gaya and OTA, Chennai respectively. This remarkable achievement reflects the values of service, dedication and excellence that define their family legacy.
Deepak's story inspires aspiring youth to pursue their dreams with conviction, proving that with dedication, perseverance and unwavering commitment, any challenge can be overcome and any goal achieved.

Army Training Command marked the 78th Army Day by organising a “Know Your Army Mela” at The Ridge, Shimla.

 The mela was inaugurated by 91-year-old veteran Brigadier Harjeet Singh from Shimla, in the presence of Lieutenant General Sukriti Singh Dahiya, SM, VSM, Chief of Staff, HQ ARTRAC. Military personnel and their families, NCC cadets and  School children   were present on the occasion.
The event featured  ‘Know Your Army’ exhibition, a display of infantry weapons and equipment, and an enthralling performance of military martial music by the Jammu and Kashmir Rifles Pipe Band. Special information stalls on recruitment and career opportunities in the Army were a major attraction for youth and children. The mela inspired young minds, strengthened civil–military bonds, and reinforced the Army’s commitment to the spirit of #NationFirst.

७८वें सेना दिवस पर शिमला के द रिज में 'Know Your Army' मेला

आर्मी ट्रेनिंग कमांड ने 78वें सेना दिवस के उपलक्ष्य पर शिमला के द रिज में 'Know Your Army' मेले का आयोजन किया।

मेले का उद्घाटन शिमला के 91 वर्षीय भूतपूर्व ब्रिगेडियर हरजीत सिंह के द्वारा किया गया, इस उपलक्ष्य में लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल सुकृति सिंह दहिया, SM, VSM, चीफ ऑफ स्टाफ, HQ ARTRAC भी मौजूद थे। इस मौके पर सैन्यजन उनके परिवार, NCC कैडेट और स्कूल के बच्चे भी उपस्थित थे।

इस आयोजन में ‘Know Your Army’ प्रदर्शनी, थल सेना के हथियारों और इक्विपमेंट का डिस्प्ले, और जम्मू-कश्मीर राइफल्स पाइप बैंड का मिलिट्री मार्शल म्यूज़िक का शानदार परफॉर्मेंस था।

 आर्मी में भर्ती और करियर के मौकों पर खास जानकारी वाले स्टॉल युवाओं और बच्चों के लिए खास आकर्षण थे। मेले ने युवाओं को प्रेरित किया, सिविल-मिलिट्री रिश्तों को मज़बूत किया, और #NationFirst की भावना के प्रति आर्मी की वचनबद्धता को और मज़बूत किया।

For hours, the soldiers fought the fire on difficult slopes and smoke-filled tracks along Gilbert Trail, Shourya Marg and adjoining areas. With boots on the ground, they created fire lines, controlled vulnerable pockets and prevented the blaze from reaching heritage properties, residential areas and vital military assets.

Behind every effort was a simple mission, to protect people, preserve history and ensure that no family was left unsafe. Their presence brought reassurance to the local population as Army columns worked through heat, smoke and fatigue to keep Kasauli secure. The timely and determined action by #IndianArmy troops played a crucial role in dousing the fire and saving lives, heritage structures and the spirit of Kasauli Cantonment. Support from #IndianAirForce aerial sorties and local agencies further strengthened the response.

The operation reflected the human face of the #IndianArmy, always ready, always present and always committed to the people.

The project included extensive excavation, systematic dewatering, scientific shaping of the lake in a symbolic water-drop form and durable stone pitching to strengthen its banks and ensure long-term stability. The initiative has enhanced the lake’s water retention capacity, improved its overall ecological value and contributed towards a greener environment within the military station.

Blending environmental stewardship with sustainable infrastructure development, the rejuvenation of #BhairoLake reflects the #IndianArmy’s continued commitment towards conservation of natural resources, water preservation and creation of future-ready, eco-conscious military establishments.
The initiative also reinforces the spirit of collective responsibility towards nature and highlights the role of military stations in promoting sustainable living, environmental protection and community-led green practices.

A wild forest fire in the hills of #Kasauli on 26 May threatened the heritage precincts of Kasauli Cantonment.

Under the close supervision and proactive guidance of Commander, #VictoryForCertain Bde, a swift and synergised firefighting response was launched, involving troops of the #VictoryForCertain Bde, Air Force Station Kasauli, Cantonment Board Kasauli and Civil Fire Tenders.

For over 16 hours, ground columns battled the flames along Gilbert Trail, Shourya Marg and adjoining areas, preventing further spread and safeguarding critical heritage zones. The air effort by #IndianAirForce Mi-17 helicopters, through effective Bambi Bucket sorties, proved decisive in containing the blaze.

All personnel and equipment are safe. No loss of civilian or combatant life has been reported. Firefighting operations continue till the fire is fully extinguished.

#39GorkhaTrainingCentre is empowering young minds through a practical and inspiring #STEM-based summer training initiative for school students. The training capsule introduces students to the fundamentals of home appliances and electronics, air conditioners and refrigerators and solar systems. Through hands-on learning, the students are gaining practical exposure to repairing fans, understanding electrical wiring, identifying faults and troubleshooting common household appliances.

The initiative also integrates #AR and #VR-based training aids and simulators, enabling trainees to visualise internal components, simulate faults and practise procedures in a safe and controlled environment. This blend of technology and skill-based learning is helping students build confidence, curiosity and problem-solving ability.

Beyond technical knowledge, the programme is fostering discipline, innovation, self-reliance and a “repair-first” mindset to reduce electronic waste. The initiative reflects the spirit of #SkillIndia and #AtmanirbharBharat, contributing towards youth empowerment and nation building. Investing in young minds today to build a skilled, confident and future-ready India tomorrow.

#JammuAndKashmirRifles Regimental Centre, #Jabalpur undertook a mission-focused Humanitarian Assistance & Disaster Relief (#HADR) recce across seven districts of #Chhattisgarh to strengthen preparedness for monsoon-related contingencies.

The recce covered #Kabirdham, #Bemetara, #Durg, #Balod, #Khairagarh-Chhuikhadan, #Rajnandgaon and #Mohla-Manpur, with the aim of strengthening preparedness for monsoon-related contingencies and ensuring a coordinated response during flood relief and disaster situations.

The exercise provided valuable ground-level familiarisation with local terrain, relief equipment, disaster response resources and the state preparedness framework, thereby enhancing situational awareness, interoperability and joint operational synergy among all agencies.

This initiative reflects the #IndianArmy’s steadfast commitment to supporting civil authorities during emergencies and standing ready to serve the people with speed, coordination and compassion.

A seminar on “Strategic Culture in India’s Neighbourhood: Continuities, Contradictions and Contemporary Implications” was conducted at #Pithoragarh to promote informed deliberations on evolving strategic thought and its implications for regional stability and national security.

Lt Gen Anindya Sengupta, GOC-in-C #CentralCommand delivered the keynote address, highlighting the importance of strategic foresight, critical thinking and preparedness in an increasingly complex security environment.

The seminar witnessed participation by senior military officers, subject matter experts, scholars, students of #SSJUniversity Almora and #NCC cadets under the aegis of Dehradun based Think Tank #BHISM.

Deliberations focused on border management, military posturing, grey zone challenges, information influence, infrastructure development and regional competition while emphasising a calibrated, informed and proactive approach to strengthen India’s strategic resilience.

Lt Gen DG Misra, #GOC #UttarBharat delivered the Vote of Thanks, acknowledging the valuable contributions of all participants and underscoring the need for continued intellectual engagement to enhance strategic understanding and preparedness.

On the occasion of the International Day for Biological Diversity 2026, themed “Acting locally for global impact”, the #GomtiTaskForce of 137 Composite Ecological Task Force Battalion (#TerritorialArmy), 39 Gorkha Rifles, in collaboration with #LucknowDevelopmentAuthority and #TurtleSurvivalAlliance Foundation India, conducted a biodiversity awareness programme at #CGCityWetland, #Lucknow.

Students, local community members, environmental stakeholders and volunteers participated in awareness sessions, bird watching and a wetland clean-up drive, reaffirming a collective resolve to halt and reverse biodiversity loss.

Launched in Nov 2025, the CG City Wetland Rejuvenation Campaign by #GomtiTaskForce, #LDA and #TSA is aimed at restoring this vital urban wetland, a biodiversity hotspot, groundwater recharge zone and ecological buffer supporting #RiverGomti.

With sustained joint efforts, the wetland now supports 434 species and counting, reflecting the impact of community participation and local ecological action. The initiative underscores the #IndianArmy’s commitment towards nation building, ecological balance and intergenerational sustainability, where boots meet roots and duty meets ecology.

From the remote heights of #VyasValley and #Dharchula, the resilient #RungCommunity of Kumaon continues to preserve a rich legacy of culture, tradition and identity in the lap of the Himalayas. In a significant step towards cultural preservation and community connect, the Sentinels of #PanchshulBrigade established the Rung Heritage & Cultural Centre at Dharchula. The Centre was inaugurated by Lt Gen Anindya Sengupta, GOC-in-C #CentralCommand, reaffirming the #IndianArmy’s enduring commitment to the people of the border regions.

More than a structure, the Centre stands as a living symbol of inclusion, pride and nation-building. It will serve as a platform to preserve the traditions, art, language and cultural heritage of the Rung community while strengthening the bond between the people and the Armed Forces.

A 7-day Drone Training Programme for #ExServicemen was conducted at #Lucknow by Directorate General of EME in collaboration with Uttar Pradesh Purva Sainik Kalyan Nigam. The initiative trained 31 Ex-Servicemen, identified by EME Depot Battalion and UPPSKNL, under DGCA-certified instructors in simulator training, drone operations, aerial surveillance, mission planning, safety procedures and smart security technologies including CCTV integration.

The programme is a significant step towards #SkillDevelopment and #VeteranEmpowerment, preparing veterans for emerging roles in drone-based security, infrastructure monitoring and smart surveillance across Uttar Pradesh and other parts of the country.

By combining military discipline with modern technology, the initiative opens new avenues for meaningful employment and reinforces the commitment of the #IndianArmy towards the welfare, resettlement and continued contribution of veterans in nation-building.

Under the aegis of HQ Paschim UP Sub Area, #IndianArmy commemorated the first anniversary of #OpSINDOOR along with the 169th Anniversary of the 1857 Uprising at the historic Race Course, Meerut, the cradle of India’s First War of Independence.

Maj Gen Sumit Rana, #GOC HQ Paschim UP Sub Area, attended the event along with #ParamVirChakra awardee Subedar Major (Honorary Captain) Yogendra Singh Yadav, #PVC. His inspiring account of courage, sacrifice and devotion to the Nation during #OperationVijay deeply motivated the youth, #NCC cadets, soldiers and attendees.

The event witnessed enthusiastic participation by nearly 400 students, NCC cadets, soldiers and officers with an overall gathering of more than 500 attendees. Talks on the valour of the Indian Army during #OpSINDOOR, tributes to the heroes of the 1857 Uprising, stirring Pipe Band displays and Combat Evacuation drills showcased the Army’s professionalism, preparedness and patriotic spirit.

The commemoration served as a powerful bridge between India’s historic struggle for freedom and the modern #IndianArmy’s unwavering resolve to safeguard the Nation. It inspired young minds with pride, patriotism and a spirit of national service, motivating many to aspire towards a career in the Armed Forces.

A two-day #CIED Training Cadre was conducted by ##SuryaDisposers for personnel of the Railway Protection Force (#RPF), #Barabanki.

The training formed part of the Disaster Management Course being conducted at Jagjivan Ram National RPF Academy, #Lucknow, the national training academy of RPF for basic and refresher training of officers and subordinate ranks.

A total of 42 trainees participated in the cadre. The training focused on prevention, mitigation and response to IED-related disasters with special emphasis on the role of RPF as first responders.

 The cadre included tabletop exercises, group discussions, field exercises, joint drills, equipment practice and detailed classes on IED mechanisms, unexploded bomb disposal, suspected object handling and Post Blast Investigation (#PBI).
Demonstrations on safe removal of an IED from a railway bogey were conducted using specialist equipment and approved techniques. Practical training was also imparted on rail bogey search, platform search, safety procedures, response drills and coordination with specialist agencies during CIED operations.

The cadre proved to be a valuable step towards operational capacity building, technological awareness and enhanced inter-agency coordination.

The #IndianArmy stands in solidarity with the families of those affected. “𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝗶𝗻 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲, 𝗖𝗿𝗼𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝗶𝗻 𝗚𝗼𝗹𝗱.” 

A moment of immense pride as Sports Cadet Abhinov Gogoi of Boys Sports Company, 1 Signal Training Centre, Jabalpur, delivers a stellar performance at the Commonwealth Weightlifting Championship 2026, clinching 2 Gold Medals in the Youth and Junior 71 kg category.

Showcasing exceptional strength and composure on the global stage, he registered:
🔸 Snatch – 129 kg (surpassing his previous record of 123 kg)
🔸 Clean & Jerk – 155 kg
🔸 Total – 284 kg (bettering his earlier record of 278 kg)
By breaking his own records, he has once again demonstrated remarkable consistency, growth and competitive excellence at the highest level.

His achievement reflects the synergy of rigorous training, unwavering determination and the Indian Army’s commitment to nurturing sporting excellence alongside military ethos. From the training grounds to the international podium, this feat stands as a testament to the spirit of perseverance and excellence.

#CentralCommand & #MadhyaBharatArea congratulate the young champion for bringing laurels to the nation and inspiring a new generation to aim higher and strive harder.

Approximately 4,500 students from 51 schools across Meerut and adjoining regions participated with great enthusiasm. The event aimed to familiarise young minds with the Army’s role, operational capabilities and diverse career opportunities, while nurturing patriotism and national pride. A comprehensive display of military equipment and combat support systems formed the highlight of the mela. Infantry weapons, armour platforms, mobile bridging systems, medical assets and other operational gear were showcased, offering students a close look at the Army’s technological and operational prowess. Army canines, equestrian demonstrations and a stirring performance by the Army Band added energy and vibrancy to the occasion. Interactive engagements with serving personnel enabled students to understand the functioning of various arms and services and gain insights into the life, values and ethos of the Armed Forces, inspiring many towards future service. The #GOC, Pashchim UP Sub Area, attended the event as Chief Guest. A free Medical Diagnostic & Treatment Camp was successfully conducted at RTSD #Hempur, reinforcing the Indian Army’s continued commitment towards health care and welfare of its extended fraternity.

The camp was organised pursuant to the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Remount Training School & Depot, #Hempur and KVR Hospital, #Kashipur, aimed at providing quality medical treatment facilities to Defence Civilian employees at CGHS-approved rates. The initiative reflects a collaborative approach towards accessible and affordable healthcare.

A dedicated team comprising 18 specialist doctors and 20 assistant technical staff participated in the outreach effort. The camp witnessed an encouraging response, with a total of 273 beneficiaries availing free medical services. These included serving personnel, families of combatants, Defence Civilian employees and daily rated staff.

Comprehensive health check-ups were undertaken, supported by diagnostic facilities such as ECG, blood investigations and X-ray, ensuring early detection and preventive care. The initiative further underscores the Indian Army’s sustained focus on holistic welfare, community outreach and medical support infrastructure.

More than a race, this challenge is a tribute to the timeless heritage of Devbhoomi, the resilience of the human spirit and the sacred bond between people and mountains. It also reinforces the Indian Army’s commitment to promoting adventure tourism, generating local employment and contributing to sustainable regional economic growth.

A journey where tradition meets toughness and endurance finds its true meaning in the mountains.

In a significant step towards empowering border communities in #HimachalPradesh a landmark Tripartite MoU was signed between the #IndianArmy, the Government of Himachal Pradesh and Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan Pvt Ltd for socio-economic development of remote border areas.

The MoU was signed in the presence of Lt Gen DG Misra, #GOC #UttarBharat and Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu, Hon’ble Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh. 

The initiative reflects strong Military–Civil cooperation focused on inclusive growth and community resilience. The partnership aims to promote large scale cultivation of medicinal and aromatic plants empower farmers through structured training technical guidance and assured procurement generate sustainable livelihoods while reviving traditional Ayurvedic practices and strengthen Military–Civil coordination for economic development of border communities.

This initiative reinforces a shared commitment to national development by integrating security stability and livelihood generation for communities living along the borders.

On the occasion of the New Year, Lt Gen Anindya Sengupta, GOC-in-C #CentralCommand, visited formations and interacted with troops, conveying New Year greetings and reinforcing commitment to operational readiness and soldier welfare. He inaugurated new Veteran Facilities including a Veteran Lounge, reaffirming the Army’s enduring bond with veterans and their families.

The Army Commander also reviewed operational preparedness at HQ, Paschim Uttar Pradesh Sub Area(#PUPSA) and later visited HQ, Base Workshop Group EME, #Meerut, where he witnessed indigenisation and modernisation initiatives, including dual-use equipment and drone systems, aligned with Atmanirbhar Bharat and the Indian Army’s Transformation initiatives.

"𝗦𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗰𝗲, 𝗛𝗼𝗻𝗼𝘂𝗿 & 𝗛𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆" Swift intervention by the Hon’ble #ChiefMinister of #Uttar Pradesh ensured the restoration of Miss Anjana Bhatt’s ancestral home that had been forcefully occupied by anti-social elements. Yet, the deeper story is one of silent responsibility and compassion beyond the call of duty. Daughter of a late Territorial Army officer and left without family, health support and home, Miss Anjana found a guardian in the Indian Army. Through years of sustained institutional care by Madhya Uttar Pradesh Sub Area, #Lucknow, she was provided dignity, protection and reassurance. In her most difficult phase, Maj Vishal Kanaujia, appointed as her foster guardian, stood resolute. Through unwavering dedication, persistent legal pursuit and coordination with civil authorities, he helped secure her rightful home. His actions reflect the Army’s living ethos, to never abandon its own, to stand for justice and to serve with humanity. This is not just assistance. It is compassion in uniform. It is honour in action. It is the Indian Army. #IndianArmy #SuryaCommand #MadhyaUttarPradeshSubArea #CompassionInService #DutyBeyondUniform #ServiceHonourHumanity @adgpi @ProDefLko @PROdefprayagraj @PIB_India @HQ_IDS_India @PRODefDehradun @UBArea_IA

The first Regiment raised after Independence, with 3/11 GR being the first battalion raised in Free India, the Regiment has stood as a symbol of courage and steadfast commitment to the Nation. From historic battlefields to modern challenges, the Gorkha warriors have always exemplified honour, sacrifice and professionalism, carrying forward a proud martial tradition that inspires generations. With deep respect, we salute the indomitable spirit, valour and selfless service of the warriors of 11 GR who continue to guard the Nation with pride. A hybrid session on Project Garbh Sanskar was conducted at Shivam Auditorium, #CommandHospital, #Lucknow connecting formations across #CentralCommand and focusing on holistic maternal wellness through medical guidance and mindful living.

Expert talks were delivered by Prof (Dr) Reema Kumari on Diet During Pregnancy and Dr Varsha Kumari on Diet & Mind, providing practical insights to support healthy motherhood and emotional well-being. Expectant mothers, spouses and families participated with great enthusiasm, reflecting the Indian Army’s commitment to informed parenting, compassionate care and a strong support ecosystem for families.

This initiative strengthens maternal care awareness and nurtures future generations with knowledge, confidence and care.
